**经济新闻·日报 | 2026-06-11**

今日全球市场被两股力量撕裂：美伊冲突急剧升级——美国对伊朗发动新一轮打击，霍尔木兹海峡通航风险推升原油价格；同时美国通胀跳升至4.2%，特朗普却公开表态“我爱通胀”，令美联储新主席沃什面临尴尬开局。欧洲股市受制于能源冲击与ECB加息预期，中国资产则在地缘避险与结构性利好（比亚迪登顶、AI泡沫警告）间摇摆。

- **[美伊冲突再燃：油价飙升，美股期货延续跌势](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/brent-wti-oil-prices-us-launches-fresh-strikes-on-iran-.html)** — 美国周四对伊朗多个目标实施打击，布伦特原油跳涨。尽管特朗普称谈判接近，但市场开始定价“冲突长期化”风险，标普500、纳指、道指期货同步下滑。
- **[特朗普谈通胀：4.2%的CPI反而成为“好消息”](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/10/trump-inflation-fed-chair-kevin-warsh-analysis.html)** — 总统表示“我爱通胀”，并认为战事结束后价格会自动回落。这一表态被解读为给新任美联储主席沃什松绑，但华尔街担忧通胀预期脱锚。
- **[甲骨文财报亮眼但股价下跌：拟再融资200亿美元](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/10/oracle-orcl-q4-earnings-report-2026.html)** — 虽然营收与利润超预期，但自由现金流转负+大规模资本开支计划令投资者疑虑云数据中心投资回报。
- **[欧洲股市多数收跌：ECB利率决议前能源压力成焦点](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxNUElaRC1iV2QxcGRickFtaldTLWtPd3VrRTRBUHBWaFQxOWxoaG43a2hTdUhOREFrOVBqZ0xxN3BSSk8wWTJZUElwTjFoeGZ1UEJmdVlnME5INnFtc0JPRzl5MGR5eXctdklla1RuVUJSTGc1MVF6WWRKOC02VmNuLTVxR05nY0dJMGRGemdEdVFIc3pHWEFhUTM0MzRWTGZSR0g2RmdYQ2ZSLUwxOXVURHV5VUZIM0pnRzhiS3I4ZFBwMVk)** — 欧洲主要指数承压，市场预期ECB将谨慎加息，同时伊朗冲突推升能源进口成本，滞胀风险浮现。
- **[中国股市低开：地缘风险与外需担忧共振](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiqAFBVV95cUxQbHROdU9nVnlLOUJSYlB1SHZkemxCZ1dZUDVZOUY4cEZHRXhsQ0JsSmx2cWVOVVV6THZtT1ZWQ2xZYUZqV05kUFRxZHV3S0poY3ZrN05hdmluaHJoYzRUYUttSlBIR0JsczRLamgxTjA5STNRZjdiMFpuX0xxb3NOVy1GUUZ5ZnZqLWNZOWhHejlzV0ZMRmFaa2kyQnR5eXRtZ1RwLWplSFk)** — 沪指与深成指早盘跌0.3%-0.4%，但银行和石油股走强；港股恒指跌0.66%，市场避险情绪主导。
- **[比亚迪逆袭登顶：能源危机重写中国车市格局](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356667/byd-powers-past-geely-oil-shock-charges-global-ev-demand)** — 全球油价飙升刺激电动车需求，比亚迪在Q2反超吉利重新成为国内最大车企，并计划五年内超越丰田成为全球第一。
- **[全球AI交易发出“dot-com”式警示信号](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356617/global-ai-trade-flashing-signals-reminiscent-dotcom-bust-analysts-warn)** — 美银指出，AI板块估值分化已达2000年互联网泡沫前夕水平，叠加SpaceX等巨量IPO抽血，调整风险不容忽视。
- **[同花顺社区：沪金闪崩、中字头暴拉，情绪剧烈分化](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTE1EV0xPY3k0a0ZwQnJQWE41b2IzVENmQTk5Skc1anJ0MW9NRGp1bWpfRjY5NVNxM2JyTmJidTlaTFF0ci1ydmVpOTdNY1lpWnNWM2ZfUXpvelJRbTlPRVE)** — 沪金主力合约因加息预期骤升一度闪崩超4%；中字头个股获80万手封单涨停；7000亿光模块龙头筹划赴港上市，显示资金在避险与成长间拉锯。

**后续观察**：霍尔木兹海峡通航状况及伊朗是否报复将是油价短期方向的关键；关注6月24日美联储银行压力测试结果；欧洲央行本周利率决议若鹰派加息，将进一步压制风险资产。中国方面需观察稳增长政策能否对冲外需放缓，比亚迪的“五年目标”将对全球汽车供应链产生深远影响。
economy.en:
Global markets tilted risk-off over the past 24 hours as the United States launched fresh military strikes against Iran, sending oil prices sharply higher and reigniting fears of sustained energy disruption. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq futures extended their slide, while European benchmarks closed mostly lower ahead of the ECB's critical rate decision. China and Hong Kong markets also fell, caught between regional risk aversion and domestic macro headwinds. The key driver is the intersection of geopolitical conflict and inflation: US CPI hit a three-year high of 4.2%, and President Trump said 'I love the inflation,' complicating the central bank outlook.

- **Oil jumps on U.S.-Iran escalation**: Brent and WTI surged after the U.S. military struck 'multiple targets' in Iran at Trump's direction. Analysts still assume a deal will eventually reopen the Strait of Hormuz, but the near-term supply risk is acute. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/brent-wti-oil-prices-us-launches-fresh-strikes-on-iran-.html), [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/10/business/oil-gas-price-iran.html))
- **Inflation at 4.2% stings**: The May CPI print, the third consecutive monthly increase since the Iran war began, drove a 'Trump loves inflation' narrative. New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh may welcome the data as it validates the need for tighter policy. ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/10/inflation-report-rate), [CNBC analysis](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/10/trump-inflation-fed-chair-kevin-warsh-analysis.html))
- **ECB faces a 'cautious hike' dilemma**: With energy prices soaring and the eurozone economy fragile, the ECB is expected to raise rates at its June meeting. Policymakers weigh the risk of 'two possible mistakes' amid the Iran war. ## 军事新闻日报 2026-06-11

**导语**：过去24小时，全球军事格局被美伊冲突的急剧升级所主导。美国以“阿帕奇被击落”为由对伊朗本土发动空袭，伊朗革命卫队随即用无人机和导弹攻击驻巴林的美国第五舰队，双方正从代理人摩擦走向直接军事对抗。与此同时，俄乌战线、台海技术验证、欧洲防务重组与印太海军合作等议题也在同步发酵。以下是各子板块的详细分析。

### 冲突局势
- **美伊全面交火**：美国连续两天对伊朗南部目标实施打击，起因是美军一架阿帕奇直升机被击落。伊朗则宣称已向巴林和约旦的美军设施发射无人机和导弹，其中攻击第五舰队的行为标志着战事升级至区域战争边缘。以色列已进入戒备状态，准备应对伊朗可能发射的导弹。[U.S. Launches Strikes on Iran in Response to Downed Apache Helicopter (WSJ)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNT1NCUi1ER19KYTBHTk80MkdYQjBxSUlJTUpKU3hNejFxZ09SYWZYV1llVlJVWlhuZUhWRENyeHpJbG5ILV9hNTN5Wi1rR1YyWm5ub2xWY2Q4dEtHMkEwVVo3V2dRSjU2R1Z2dE1oSlpBSUluOTQxdjFpUWF3ZTBhWElCVzg0LUFf) ｜ [Iran Strikes US Fifth Fleet In Bahrain (Modern Ghana)](https://news.google.) ｜ [Israel Braces for Iranian Missiles (Haaretz)](https://news.google.)
- **俄乌战线动态**：普京拒绝了泽连斯基提出的谈判条件，战争烈度持续。乌克兰对俄罗斯境内军事和能源设施发动远程打击，而瑞典宣布将向乌克兰提供16架“鹰狮”战斗机及200公里射程导弹，可能迫使俄军调整防空部署。[Putin rejects Zelenskyy’s talks offer (MSN)](https://news.google.) ｜ [Sweden is sending Ukraine 16 Gripen jets (OkDiario)](https://news.google.) ｜ [Ukraine launches long-range strikes (Los Angeles Times)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwgFBVV95cUxOYlMtTzFnMGdMMEhaQ1JnSmlickUzTTJRdm8xdDdTNllUT1FTQ0pSZTUzUERfOFRRYkZPUUU1NzJyN1l0eHQtdUxSbVlMNjdIQjN4VXFIVDN2dnlIT2l6Sl9sRkFKRkZNSVljY0hpT2Y0UnRLeTgyOEtzY3N1TWxCaUZEdVRLRmwyWDk0ay1IclRxOTdYZ2RXUTVHTEVpWVBHSWJURGJWZjVPaHp5NTZEV2V4UU1yZ1dudFZNY2pBYWRjdw)
- **其他线索**：土耳其正悄悄调整立场，从俄罗斯转向北约（[Foreign Affairs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTFB6Ry13YVBtN293anRJRWZhOGdtUWtOUkllajJTbF9vVG9TVE9ubkUyTE1SOXZQbHNHUVl5UEQwV01nYWVXak1teG1FSjR4OXhTUklfanZVd2Y1Sm9KSkdjRXZnb2tyOGdWR25oMm85UVU)）；乌克兰正尝试争取阿拉伯世界舆论支持（[Ukrinform](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMitwFBVV95cUxNOXVTV09YWTl6N2ZJV3o0MkxvZk9MZmtFUVYzblFZMFR6d2gwLXhQYkRaNDRyMU9RS3hCcFdBX2VKVGlDYWdxdkRBNHo3UTg2MTN3YnNnTE1Kblc3dV9VRHNNUHR1MkNLQVprSTlQLTZwaGlzekc3NWhYUUF1VW9saWVhTkswallfSEJrQXhZLWpZWnJETG01MHZZV205WGlIYzV4RmxkTWZmd2pBbkJyS0FDTUZUMlU)）。

**后续观察**：美伊冲突是否会在未来48小时内进一步扩大，取决于伊朗是否动员真主党或胡塞武装开辟第二战线，以及美国是否会转向打击伊朗核设施。同时，瑞典支援乌克兰的鹰狮战机交付时间表将直接影响东线空中平衡。

### 国际安全
- **美伊冲突激化**：美国对伊朗连续两天空袭，伊朗革命卫队宣布攻击了巴林的美第五舰队和约旦目标。一夜之间，4月8日以来的停火协议几近破裂，地区局势高度紧张。[Overnight Attacks Rattle U.S.-Iran Ceasefire (The War Zone)](https://www.twz.com/news-features/overnight-attacks-rattle-u-s-iran-ceasefire) ｜ [US strikes Iran in second day of renewed fire (WHEC.com)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOdmo0X3FrOGRCRUF4VVlxTjdTM3RhcVN2TkFmdjhTLUVvMDlubDJDTktCWC1DQ2Z2TlJnYjFhSlF4bEsyMElpQi1RRVk2WUtQdGpYOXd2VFdDUVdrVDd6SGVhWnFxM3hoYzgtQ3hVUkRJenlqVHI1R3dDMFVTWlh0RTI5ZVBEZw)
- **台海技术试验**：台湾军队首次在实弹演习中使用美制攻击无人机打击海上目标，验证了远程打击系统在“反入侵”场景中的有效性。[Taiwanese Forces Deploy American-made Attack Drones Against Maritime Targets (USNI News)](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/taiwanese-forces-deploy-american-made-attack-drones-against-maritime-targets)
- **欧洲空中力量革新**：德国展示“眼镜蛇600”喷气动力拦截无人机，可携带IRIS-T导弹在数百公里外拦截目标；波音则推出第三版“幽灵蝙蝠”，具备内部弹舱可挂载AIM-120中距弹。[Germany’s Cobra 600 (The War Zone)](https://www.twz.com/air/germanys-cobra-600-is-a-jet-powered-interceptor-drone-that-slings-an-iris-t-missile) ｜ [Boeing’s New Larger Ghost Bat (The War Zone)](https://www.twz.com/air/boeings-new-larger-ghost-bat-can-carry-aim-120-amraams-internally)
- **美国防务预算**：众院拨款委员会公布2027财年1万亿美元国防法案，重点聚焦供应链脱钩，将中国列为“主要战略对手”。[House appropriators release $1 trillion defense bill (Breaking Defense)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNVnVYeEFqcnJYUVZZbk9JbmwyTUxuT3pFSlVDSVpENW5rS2VNSGRwcV9VcFl0alFqdUFDRVVOR3lHMm0zZjdYamdiei1xVDVKZmxwcFNPRUU2c0JuemNtanFmOGRfb0lGQUVMRUxGd09IRV95cFR5TkZ3YjRxOVVraHRrdnQ4bW9xcHFqNFloaFJKeXhZdTVueEFUUllrZw)
- **海上无人机救援**：美军在伊朗附近实施了一次靠无人艇完成的直升机坠毁救援，凸显无人系统在实战搜救中的潜力。[Drone rescue highlights US Navy's autonomous push (Al-Monitor)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMimAFBVV95cUxNM3FLWE9WYlNnVV9naWZMUXdzX3pIeG0xd3ZpcXdtQVZMbUsxZkxNbjFuQ2dlaDAtNndNYjFDYTJqUjZRRzg5NGtKZUs5SkVrdFF2ME9vTFNUdWhGT2dqa3JvOWNzdlIwdE14R0liSjRjZGw0OHlKeThvNHpjUFBjTnlZd0Q0ZmkwOXVZenZ6eTdXZmRqTmc1MQ)

**后续观察**：美伊冲突的不可预测性是本周最大风险；台湾无人机实战化测试将加速美国对台军售决策；欧洲无人战机的发展可能改写空战规则。

### 海军与印太
- **台海海上无人机测试**：台湾使用美制攻击无人机打击海上目标，标志着其非对称战力的实质性突破。该型无人机在模拟交战回路后成功命中离岸靶标，未来可能在反登陆作战中发挥关键作用。[Taiwanese Forces Deploy American-made Attack Drones Against Maritime Targets (USNI News)](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/taiwanese-forces-deploy-american-made-attack-drones-against-maritime-targets)
- **美国下一代战略核潜艇**：哥伦比亚级首艇“哥伦比亚特区号”（SSBN-826）的艇首和艇尾分段照片在社交平台曝光，X型尾舵设计和水下静音能力备受关注。[New Look at America’s Next Ballistic Missile Submarine (Naval News)](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/new-look-at-americas-next-ballistic-missile-submarine/)
- **BALTOPS 2026演习启动**：北约在波罗的海开始年度联合演习，今年规模缩减至20艘舰艇、6000人，原因是部分舰艇被调往中东。演习首次由联合部队司令部布鲁塞尔（JFC Brunssum）指挥。[BALTOPS 2026 Exercise Begins (USNI News)](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/baltops-2026-exercise-begins)
- **日韩恢复海上搜救合作**：日本海上自卫队“金刚”号驱逐舰与韩国海军在五岛列岛以西举行联合搜救演习，这是自2017年以来首次，标志两国军事关系回暖。[Japan And South Korea Resume SAREX After Nine-Year Hiatus (Naval News)](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/japan-and-south-korea-resume-sarex-after-nine-year-hiatus/)
- **葡萄牙海军换装**：西班牙EM&E公司将为葡萄牙海军提供47座遥控武器站，合同通过北约支持与采购局签署，体现北约内部装备标准化趋势。[EM&E to Supply 47 Remote Weapon Stations to Portuguese Navy (Naval News)](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/eme-to-supply-47-remote-weapon-stations-to-portuguese-navy/)

**后续观察**：台湾无人机实弹测试将刺激大陆方面相应反制手段的研发；哥伦比亚级潜艇是未来美国海基核威慑的主力，其建造进度影响战略平衡；日韩军事交流若能持续，可能推动更深入的安全合作。

### 中国军情
- **中国反驳日本抹黑**：针对日方指责中国正常军事活动“增加地区紧张”，中国外交部与中华网均予以驳斥，称日方“无端指责…欺骗公众”。[外交部：日方无端指责抹黑中国正常军事活动 (中国青年网)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiZ0FVX3lxTFBHdjhNTmxfazRQNjdDUmxIdVBLT2V2LXphc0dNQ3ozaHFVLWJZLXdXY2RzbHNUamNWS1AwWU9KcF8yb0YzSFdJYTBUakRpQnBxSE9yNlpRMVlOS1JtM1lDOEI1TVF6VFE) ｜ [日方无端指责抹黑中国正常军事活动 (中华网)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9lXzV3dU8wbC1yNWtNQzVmaGRUNWYwem91bFhWWDgwWklRVVV5cVpwbWltTkNXUXJuQXhoMEI0Y0FUNGVGVF9ubHhCZmhxQ05UYUZOR282ajgyWDZWZE9KUmVpUVZWTURLRDRLb1VRMTE)
- **美国扩大“中国军工企业”清单**：美国会委员会审议的2027国防授权法将中国列为主要战略对手，并新增比亚迪、宇树科技等企业进入“中国军企”清单，蔚来汽车对此表示强烈反对。[美国扩大“中国军企”清单 比亚迪、宇树皆入列 (dw.com)](https://news.google.) ｜ [蔚来汽车反驳 (汽车之家)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE45VzVtQUhjbWZva3RlNVdLVXNlWWp0bUx5WDJnVW1EM3BTNEpfTEYyT0MwMWFTV25RbG1kbEsxRW9VU3lMcHJDUzRlM29qZmVsNGxoNEVzanlPeDQ)
- **捷克限制中国汽车**：捷克国防部禁止中国产汽车驶入敏感军事区域，反映欧洲对中国供应链安全的担忧正在向防务领域蔓延。[捷克国防部限制中国汽车进入敏感军事区域 (RFI)](https://news.google.)
- **西太平洋态势**：有专家警告地区“暗流涌动”，根源在于大国竞争加剧和同盟体系硬化。[西太平洋暗流涌动 (搜狐网)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNaUhPM2dlMXFGc2FSWkdncXFDa0E3UkF1dDVaSVBZT3I4X21PbHAxNDF3T19MRWU2b2NOVFBCNTBLMkVHR1BxVlQzcTlHVUhub0N5UXRVWXY3Rnd0U1VZSFlLS3Z6SDM1Tkt0eVdBRlFsWUtmcmd3Ni1PRkJnQ0F4Zk45UzBVM0pU)

**后续观察**：美国对华“军工企业”清单扩围将进一步影响中企海外融资与经营，蔚来等被迫自证清白可能导致司法诉讼；捷克等欧洲国家跟随美国限制中国产品，中欧防务关系面临新摩擦。
military.en:
The past 24 hours have seen a dramatic escalation between the United States and Iran, with both sides launching direct strikes that shatter the fragile April ceasefire. Simultaneously, the war in Ukraine enters a new phase as Sweden pledges advanced fighter jets, while the Indo-Pacific reflects deepening arms competitions—Taiwan test-fires American drones, Japan fields hypersonic weapons, and the U.S. House unveils a trillion-dollar defense bill targeting China. Below are the key developments to track.

- **U.S.-Iran tit-for-tat escalates into open hostilities**: After blaming Tehran for downing an Apache helicopter, the U.S. struck southern Iran. Iran retaliated by launching [drone and missile attacks on the U.S. Fifth Fleet in Bahrain](https://news.google.) and other Persian Gulf assets, and the U.S. continued strikes into a second day. The ceasefire is effectively dead, and Israel braces for Iranian missile retaliation.
- **Ukraine war: Putin rejects talks, Sweden sends 16 Gripen jets**: Russian President [Putin refused Zelenskyy's negotiation offer](https://news.google.) as fighting intensifies. Sweden pledged [16 Saab Gripen jets with 200-km-range missiles](https://news.google.) to Ukraine, a significant capability boost that will force Russia to adjust its air-defense posture. Ukraine also conducted long-range strikes on military and energy sites inside Russia.
- **Taiwan tests American attack drones against maritime targets**: Taiwan’s newly acquired U.S.-made attack drones [struck offshore targets in live-fire drills](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/taiwanese-forces-deploy-american-made-attack-drones-against-maritime-targets) along the west coast, validating long-range strike systems designed to counter a potential Chinese invasion. The deployment marks a tactical shift toward unmanned systems in the Taiwan Strait.
- **Japan unveils hypersonic glide vehicle to counter China**: The Japan Self-Defense Forces now field the [25HGP hypersonic glide vehicle](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMilAFBVV95cUxQSUZIYndSZGhEQi0wUldfbll3eFRfRkVCRGk1WE5sZk03QXVZRXI4cUlVbGxtZ2t4LUN1X0JNTkFpSWY5bE5MSHB3MFBaTUtpZTJVblN1VzVtN2dKYWxnVzRtZ0kxR3BMVVNKRUFSYVQ1MDMySVNwV3NROTlPLXo3VXVNNzg5dFR4MThuU0tIQlhXaS03), described as an effective response to China’s growing missile arsenal. This is part of a regional arms race as East Asia invests in speed and payload.
- **U.S. House releases $1 trillion FY27 defense bill, targets China**: The House appropriators’ [FY27 defense bill](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNVnVYeEFqcnJYUVZZbk9JbmwyTUxuT3pFSlVDSVpENW5rS2VNSGRwcV9VcFl0alFqdUFDRVVOR3lHMm0zZjdYamdiei1xVDVKZmxwcFNPRUU2c0JuemNtanFmOGRfb0lGQUVMRUxGd09IRV95cFR5TkZ3YjRxOVVraHRrdnQ4bW9xcHFqNFloaFJKeXhZdTVueEFUUllrZw) prioritizes countering China and includes provisions to decouple supply chains. Separately, the U.S. expanded its Chinese military-company blacklist to include BYD and other firms, while the Czech Republic restricted Chinese vehicles from sensitive military areas.
- **Naval developments: BALTOPS begins, new U.S. sub revealed**: NATO’s [BALTOPS 2026 exercise](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/baltops-2026-exercise-begins) kicked off with fewer ships due to redeployments to the Middle East. New images emerged of the [USS District of Columbia (SSBN-826)](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/new-look-at-americas-next-ballistic-missile-submarine/), America’s next ballistic missile submarine. Japan and South Korea resumed a [search-and-rescue exercise](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/japan-and-south-korea-resume-sarex-after-nine-year-hiatus/) after a nine-year hiatus, signaling improved bilateral military coordination.
- **European defense realignment: Germany’s air show and FCAS uncertainty**: The [ILA Berlin air show](https://www.defensenews.com/global/europe/2026/06/10/german-air-show-opens-under-shadow-of-iran-war-fighter-project-collapse/) opened under the shadow of the Iran conflict and the potential collapse of the Franco-German-Spanish Future Combat Air System (FCAS) project, with Airbus now looking to Sweden’s Saab as a preferred partner.

**Watch next**: The U.S.-Iran spiral could trigger further regional escalation—watch for [Hormuz Strait disruptions](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBDdTkwajBzNElvRko1OC01eWZiQkxlM05zU3g1c1ZPY0ZMczhaMkJaY1p1dUtNOGpKa1F0M2NaQnBMUGRYTGtCdXh2T2IzdTZBTEdvbg) and Israeli preemptive moves. The FCAS program’s fate will reshape European aerospace. Taiwan’s drone integration and Japan’s hypersonic work are signals of a broader shift to unmanned and high-speed warfare in the Indo-Pacific.

tech.zh:
今日科技板块呈现出两条鲜明主线：AI 安全与监管的全面收紧，以及比亚迪在新能源汽车领域的强势进攻。AI 领域，xAI 一名工程师因提出 Grok 安全问题被解雇后提起诉讼（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/10/xai-fired-an-engineer-who-raised-alarms-about-grok-safety-new-lawsuit-claims/)），加拿大则出台法案要求社交平台对 AI 聊天机器人承担安全责任（[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2191879/canada-announces-bill-banning-social-media-for-anyone-under-16/)），CISA 更将漏洞修复时限压缩至 3 天（[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/cisa-ai-vulnerability-directive/)）。与此同时，Google DeepMind 发布 DiffusionGemma 实现 4 倍速度提升（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/google/2026/06/googles-latest-diffusiongemma-open-ai-model-comes-with-a-4x-speed-boost/)），而 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 却被曝拒绝回答基础生物问题（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/947973/fable-wont-answer-basic-biology-questions)），AI 的能力边界与透明度争议持续发酵。科技产品方面，Valve 因诈骗问题停售实体 Steam 礼品卡（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/06/valve-kills-its-retail-gift-card-program-due-to-scammers/)），近百万份护照证件数据在线暴露（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/947157/passports-data-breach-cannabis-club-systems-nefos-puffpal)），Xbox 预告将大幅裁员（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/games/948142/microsoft-xbox-layoffs-reset-asha-sharma)）。汽车板块几乎被比亚迪霸屏：该公司威胁起诉美国防部将其列入“中国军事企业”名单（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-threatens-sue-trump-administration-pentagon-military-list/)），宣布五年内超越丰田成为全球最大车企（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-outsold-ford-thinks-it-can-catch-toyota-for-no-1/)），并计划在加拿大部署 5 分钟快充网络（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-flash-charging-canada-5-minute-ev-charging-network/)）。HackNews 社区热议的话题包括：一个基于 π 的数字文件系统 πFS（[GitHub](https://github.com/philipl/pifs)）、Claude Desktop 每次启动生成 1.8GB 虚拟机的资源浪费（[GitHub](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/29045)），以及农民捐赠土地却被政府转卖为数据中心用地引发的伦理讨论（[Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/farmer-donates-land-for-a-park-city-sells-it-for-data-center-development-usd10-gift-became-usd10m-for-city-government-with-usd30m-tax-expected-over-next-decade)）。

**后续观察**：AI 监管正从呼吁转向立法与执法，xAI 案可能成为行业 whistleblower 保护的风向标；比亚迪的全球扩张节奏与美国政府的贸易壁垒形成正面碰撞，将深刻影响未来五年汽车产业格局；社区对 AI 模型资源消耗的批评揭示了部署成本与环境影响的矛盾，需要持续追踪大模型供应商的优化承诺与实际表现。
tech.en:
The past 24 hours in tech are dominated by three converging forces: the relentless acceleration of AI deployment and its costs, the unstoppable rise of BYD in the global automotive order, and a wave of security breaches and regulatory pushback. Google and Anthropic both unveiled faster, more powerful models—but concerns over safety, job displacement, and even student protests are mounting. In the data-center gold rush, GM is pivoting to sodium-ion batteries for energy storage, while Amazon borrows another $17.5B to fund AI. Meanwhile, BYD’s CEO confidently predicts it will overtake Toyota in five years, backed by blistering 1,500 kW charging networks expanding into Canada. Security headlines are grim: North Korean hackers account for half of U.S. tech industry breaches, a facial recognition lawsuit highlights flawed policing, and Valve kills physical Steam gift cards due to scammers. The Hacker News community is deeply engaged with discussions on AI bloat, efficient language design, and data-center land grabs. **Watch for** the fallout from the German court ruling that rejected Google’s AI-augmented search, potentially reshaping the search industry; the impending Xbox layoffs; and the impact of Canada’s social media ban bill on AI chatbot services.

- [Why Andrew Yang is building instead of waiting for Washington](https://techcrunch.com/video/why-andrew-yang-is-building-instead-of-waiting-for-washington/) — Yang warns that UBI is now mainstream, as Dario Amodei, Sam Altman, and Bernie Sanders echo his 2020 message on AI-driven labor disruption.
- [Google's New AI Model Hits 1,000 Tokens Per Second On Nvidia GPUs](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMid0FVX3lxTE1qZW5kWWlkVmpwVDY4NkhHdkN5NDhacURqeXM0UU9WOVlUR1pZZDlxOUgzRnhyb19sNF9YRk5EOGJiaHl3TVVrdWF0U3VlYVJKaWI4OHNLUG8yWEdMVkVmQmdQek9ibVlHR1ZQdWRVemRRVTMtQVVN) — Performance leap raises the bar for real-time inference, but also intensifies energy and hardware demands.
- [Fresh off bond sale, Amazon borrows $17.5B from banks as AI spending continues](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/10/fresh-off-bond-sale-amazon-borrows-17-5-billion-from-banks-as-ai-spending-continues/) — Corporate debt for AI arms race is climbing; AWS capital expenditure is unsustainable without massive borrowing.
- [BYD chairman says firm will be world’s biggest automaker in 5 years as shares slide](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-outsold-ford-thinks-it-can-catch-toyota-for-no-1/) — BYD threatens to sue Pentagon over “Chinese military company” designation, while pushing 1,500 kW Flash Charging into Canada.
- [CISA Tells US Agencies to Fix Security Bugs in as Little as 3 Days Thanks to AI Threats](https://www.wired.com/story/cisa-ai-vulnerability-directive/) — “Defenders cannot afford to take weeks to patch,” warning that AI accelerates vulnerability exploitation.
- [Man sues Florida cops over arrest spurred by '93% match' in facial recognition](https://arstechnica.com/tech-policy/2026/06/man-jailed-due-to-faulty-face-recognition-says-florida-cops-ignored-other-evidence/) — Lawsuit alleges “police let an error-prone AI system stand in for an investigation,” highlighting civil rights risks.
- [North Koreans behind nearly half of US tech industry hacks, says CrowdStrike](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/10/north-koreans-behind-nearly-half-of-us-tech-industry-hacks-says-crowdstrike/) — Remote IT worker fraud remains a persistent, under-reported threat to global supply chains.

**Watch next:** The outcome of the German court case against Google’s AI Overviews could set precedent for how AI-generated search results are regulated in Europe; the Xbox “reset” and layoffs will signal Microsoft’s gaming strategy shift; and BYD’s legal battle with the Pentagon may escalate trade tensions.

sports.zh:
距世界杯开幕仅剩数日，赛场内外风波不断。英格兰热身赛因极端天气延迟，引发对赛事组织的担忧；FIFA主席因凡蒂诺三年首度发声却呼吁‘冷静放松’，被批评未展现领导力。转会市场暗流涌动：皇马1.5亿报价阿尔瓦雷斯遭马竞拒绝，同时以2000万欧锁定邓弗里斯至2030年。羽毛球领域，安洗莹成为历史首位生涯奖金突破300万美元的女单选手，而国羽在澳大利亚公开赛首轮12战9胜。NBA季后赛争议不断，东契奇因对裁判做不雅手势被罚5万美元。虎扑社区因孙颖莎入选权威榜单引发跨圈热议。

- 英格兰热身风暴延迟：英格兰与哥斯达黎加的比赛因极端天气推迟，是世界杯临场风险的预演？详见[报道](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cr47lp04n34o)。
- 因凡蒂诺危机公关失分：面对索马里裁判被拒入境争议，FIFA主席仅以‘chill, relax’回应，缺乏决断力。来源[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cvgj40vymlyo)与[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13552857/world-cup-2026-fifa-president-gianni-infantino-says-chill-and-relax-after-somali-referee-denied-us-visa)。
- 皇马两笔交易一成一败：1.5亿报价阿尔瓦雷斯遭马竞拒绝（[虎扑](https://news.google.)），同时邓弗里斯2000万欧签约至2030年（[虎扑](https://news.google.)）。
- 安洗莹创奖金纪录：韩国女单一姐生涯奖金突破300万美元，获世界羽联官方认证，[报道](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxORmhldm4yeG5qVXp5cXJRNU5JSUxMdXVnNWtla0ZEVGJOQS1BSmhQbHpLZ3BYUjh0SVY1bXBBeWtBN0p3blhlM1hDUnNsOEIzZHZRSThEYVdoTkxxX2l6Q3NDUnVKUDc2OUlONlhheG5QLTAyYWRtaUUzVDFQaEV2Q2tGTmxOb0hfSnJteQ)。
- 东契奇因不雅手势被罚5万美元：NBA官方罚款，[来源](https://news.google.)。
- 澳大利亚羽毛球公开赛国羽强势：首轮中国选手12战9胜，“凤凰”“梁王”完胜晋级，[综述](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOT0Iwa1ByOE50cTJyODdTdDRQak5pRHNyM3J6cjk5YmIyNkJ0OENTLVpiZEtLb1czQ3RkRWFHbWprV2RSM0NEOEJQbnp3WGhJSnhKbkRDQVI1N25tSkYwU3pNcEdXZktJNThzandSM20zTXNmTlpmRUd0VmlqNDg4bG1pMV80a0NhR042R242TXBSY3M1cll6dDg2NkcxZw)。
- 虎扑社区风暴：孙颖莎与梅西、C罗等顶流同登权威榜单，引发虎扑男用户热议，[微博链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8yRDQxT3BnVWFDcWdwcElrWWxDbmRBTlBVcHhmX0tzVmE0aGpBVW1ZUm5mb1pmYk9SVTZNWDhSRlVlc1QxS01VbEZkdHFTd1dFczh6SzczYUZLamZueUZwMEJkVQ)。

**后续观察：** 世界杯前的组织风险与转会博弈将是未来48小时焦点；羽毛球赛季进入密集赛程，国羽状态值得跟踪；NBA总决赛激战正酣，联盟对球员行为零容忍的态度持续强化。
sports.en:
The past 24 hours have delivered a whirlwind of news across the sports landscape, with football's World Cup countdown dominating headlines. Thomas Tuchel faces crucial lineup decisions as England finalizes preparations, while FIFA President Gianni Infantino's controversial 'chill and relax' response to a Somali referee being denied a US visa has sparked debate about World Cup organization. Meanwhile, the Chinese sports community is abuzz with reaction to Sun Yingsha's inclusion in a prestigious global list, and badminton sees history made with An Se-young's prize money milestone. Key NBA off-court news includes Luka Doncic's fine and Patrick Mahomes' record-breaking NFL contract extension.

- **England's World Cup readiness tested**: After a storm-delayed friendly against Costa Rica, questions remain about Tuchel's starting XI. [Bellingham at number 10? Will Saka start? It's decision time for Tuchel](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cz9lxld1892o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC Sport
- **Infantino under fire**: FIFA president dismisses concerns over a Somali referee barred from entering the US, saying 'chill, relax'. [Infantino could have stood up for the World Cup - but he said 'chill, relax'](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cvgj40vymlyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC Sport
- **McKenna leaves Ipswich**: The manager resigns citing family time, just before the Premier League season. [Family time, not Fulham time - McKenna leaves Ipswich](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cd7wn0erlvwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC Sport
- **Stunning athletics upset**: 17-year-old Cooper Lutkenhaus beats Olympic champion Emmanuel Wanyonyi in Oslo Diamond League 800m. [Lutkenhaus, 17, upsets Olympic champion Wanyonyi in Oslo](https://www.bbc.com/sport/athletics/articles/cg5374y6rv1o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC Sport
- **Mahomes signs $500M contract**: The NFL's first fully guaranteed half-billion deal. [Mahomes signs record-breaking $500m Chiefs contract](https://www.skysports.com/nfl/news/12040/13552870/patrick-mahomes-kansas-city-chiefs-quarterback-to-make-over-500m-after-signing-contract-extension) — Sky Sports
- **Chinese netizens react to Sun Yingsha list**: The table tennis star makes a global top athletes list alongside Messi, Ronaldo, LeBron, triggering heated discussion. [see 虎扑 desk](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8yRDQxT3BnVWFDcWdwcElrWWxDbmRBTlBVcHhmX0tzVmE0aGpBVW1ZUm5mb1pmYk9SVTZNWDhSRlVlc1QxS01VbEZkdHFTd1dFczh6SzczYUZLamZueUZwMEJkVQ)
- **Badminton milestones**: An Se-young becomes first player to exceed $3 million in career prize money, while Chinese players dominate Australian Open first round. [历史第一人！安洗莹生涯奖金突破300万美元](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxORmhldm4yeG5qVXp5cXJRNU5JSUxMdXVnNWtla0ZEVGJOQS1BSmhQbHpLZ3BYUjh0SVY1bXBBeWtBN0p3blhlM1hDUnNsOEIzZHZRSThEYVdoTkxxX2l6Q3NDUnVKUDc2OUlONlhheG5QLTAyYWRtaUUzVDFQaEV2Q2tGTmxOb0hfSnJteQ)
- **Doncic fined for obscene gesture**: NBA slaps $50k fine on Luka Doncic for inappropriate hand signal to referee. [NBA官方：东契奇因对裁判做不雅手势被罚款5 万美元](https://news.google.)

**Watch next**: Keep an eye on Tuchel's final 23-man squad announcement, the fallout from the McKenna departure at Ipswich, and further developments in the Chinese fan debates around athlete rankings. The Australian Badminton Open continues with Chinese players in action.

entertainment.zh:
今日娱乐头条交织着怀旧与争议：BIGBANG以31场世界巡演庆祝20周年，泰勒·斯威夫特与特朗普意外同框NBA总决赛；国内微博被迪丽热巴陈飞宇“情侣手链”刷屏，胡彦斌易梦玲分手传闻持续发酵；黄晓明48岁考博成功获赞，华谊兄弟却因股东股票拍卖股价大跌。以下为各子板块精选动态。

- [BIGBANG宣布31场世界巡演](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bigbang-2026-world-tour-dates-1235573633/)：G-Dragon、太阳、大声合体，覆盖亚洲、北美、欧洲、澳洲，20周年纪念巡演能否重现当年盛况？
- [泰勒·斯威夫特现身NBA总决赛](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/taylor-swift-nba-finals-new-york-knicks-1236771748/)，从《玩具总动员5》首映赶场麦迪逊广场花园支持尼克斯，而特朗普也到场引发尼克斯球迷“烧鼠尾草”抗议（[Variety](https://variety.com/2026/scene/news/knicks-trump-curse-fans-protest-msg-barriers-1236772041/)），文体跨界话题性十足。
- [斯皮尔伯格自曝屡次申请执导詹姆斯·邦德被拒](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/steven-spielberg-james-bond-movies-rejected-offer-direct-1236771411/)：他在播客中表示“现在你们请不起我”，引发影迷对007系列未来走向的猜测。
- [迪丽热巴陈飞宇被曝佩戴情侣手链](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFA3Wk8xT0loQTVsZ0NoV1pmaHhEM0doNlN0bV9QcnFaQkJjeUx0WmdLdHZIeXNiTFQyU2hxeWpWYWNHVTRRNkxWbnlzOHlRd20zNlpiMUNYU3RFSUc5Vl9pWEpqWQ) 登顶热搜，双方暂未回应，粉丝阵营激烈争论。
- [黄晓明回应博士上岸](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNSm9FaXMyeTlxcWdWYzVsNEE1OG4wWnVzLW9XQXJKUExWRGYzTGFMNzhEblk2alM1U2JyNUtXT2o3Q2c5ZHc5bS0yRFhrQTBLMVhmT2h5YjQtNmpHVmc4ZzdVLVgtV3FOeEQ1SlhwaTU1Y3hUV01LUThPUGcyZEFadTZ3)：48岁推掉戏约备考一年终获录取，成为内娱“学霸”新标杆。
- [华谊兄弟王忠军2800万股股票被拍卖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE8xSWdTc1lVdkZBWlhZWF9hSUZHbmdISjl0Wjh3a19GVUc2eXBKVHV1NmpoaDFjemdXU3dfVDg3U2tSdDNKdzFVNVFpalFreXdkS2NhSzk0UEhQSlpyM0RsYU1IbS1hM01R)，公司股价大跌近5%，影视行业资本寒意未消。

**后续观察**：BIGBANG巡演票务表现将检验K-pop老牌男团的市场号召力；迪丽热巴陈飞宇绯闻若持续发酵可能影响新剧《白日提灯》口碑；黄晓明博士身份或为其转型提供新背书，但需警惕过度营销反噬。
entertainment.en:
In the last 24 hours, the entertainment landscape has been dominated by a mix of blockbuster celebrity sightings, unexpected career moves, and industry milestones. Taylor Swift's surprise appearance at the NBA Finals in New York overshadowed the game itself, while BIGBANG announced a massive 31-show world stadium tour for their 20th anniversary. The Chinese internet is buzzing over rumored relationships and a prominent actor's academic achievement, while Hollywood sees new projects and candid admissions from legends like Steven Spielberg.

- **Taylor Swift courts the NBA Finals**: Swift attended Game 3 of the Knicks vs. Spurs series at Madison Square Garden, drawing massive fan attention alongside other A-listers like Timothée Chalamet and Spike Lee ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/taylor-swift-nba-finals-new-york-knicks-1236771748/)). Meanwhile, Knicks fans protested and performed a sage-cleansing ritual outside the arena, blaming President Trump's presence for a potential curse ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/scene/news/knicks-trump-curse-fans-protest-msg-barriers-1236772041/)).
- **BIGBANG goes global**: The K-pop titans announced a 31-date world stadium tour spanning Asia, North America, Europe, and Australia, reuniting G-Dragon, Taeyang, and Daesung for their 20th anniversary ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bigbang-2026-world-tour-dates-1235573633/)).
- **Spielberg finally speaks on Bond rejection**: The director revealed James Bond producers constantly turned him down, and now he says, 'You can't afford me' ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/steven-spielberg-james-bond-movies-rejected-offer-direct-1236771411/)).
- **Mindy Kaling closes her TV trilogy**: Her new Hulu series 'Not Suitable for Work' completes a 'loosely' self-based trilogy, expanding her comedic universe ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/mindy-kaling-not-suitable-for-work-self-based-tv-trilogy-1236953379/)).
- **Chinese social media ablaze**: Shu Qi's refusal to airbrush wrinkles sparked a trending debate on beauty standards ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTFA1Qmw5OWRlSE5XUTNIb0oxS1d4TFFRRmp3WlJ4amxyalVHMGtqc1BFLU5iWVlBeXRBa3YwN2JGd2NncFc0NmFrYnRwenBtekk)), while Dilraba Dilmurat and Chen Feiyu faced dating rumors that fans quickly labeled as manufactured ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFA3Wk8xT0loQTVsZ0NoV1pmaHhEM0doNlN0bV9QcnFaQkJjeUx0WmdLdHZIeXNiTFQyU2hxeWpWYWNHVTRRNkxWbnlzOHlRd20zNlpiMUNYU3RFSUc5Vl9pWEpqWQ)).
- **Huang Xiaoming earns PhD at 48**: The veteran Chinese actor successfully entered a doctoral program after a year of intense preparation, drawing widespread praise ([Oriental Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE55bTduSEM0RlNucmFaTzk1ajMwejdwckpnV1hkM0labXNSV2s0ZUl6bjBESUdVc0pSdFJsM083VHFpUGdwdzZvdVM1VUZoVlFIRXBqWmdyZ0dET19MWWx5alVBNEtMQi1MT3dlU25IYm9Bc2xGTnVfVA)).
- **Industry shifts**: JioHotstar's microdrama platform Tadka crossed 100 million users, signaling a boom in short-form content in India ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/tadka-jiohotstar-100-million-users-microdrama-1236771461/)), while Hollywood studios and unions quietly reached four-year labor agreements without major conflict ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/why-hollywoods-2026-labor-negotiations-so-sleepy-1236618886/)).

**Watch next**: Keep an eye on the Knicks-Spurs Finals for more celebrity sightings and fan reactions, and track BIGBANG ticket sales as the tour dates drop. The Dilraba-Chen Feiyu rumor mill may escalate if exclusive photos emerge. Also, the upcoming Taormina Film Festival will likely generate more 'House of the Dragon' buzz as season 3 previews continue.

美股.zh:
**美股：地缘炸弹与通胀热浪夹击，大盘承压**

美伊冲突急转直下，美国周四对伊朗发动新一轮打击，油价应声大涨。同时5月CPI同比升至4.2%（创三年新高），特朗普却公开表示“我爱通胀”，暗示战事结束后物价自然回落，这为新任美联储主席沃什提供了不急于收紧的理由。三大指数期货延续跌势，市场情绪脆弱。
- **[美国对伊朗实施新打击，原油跳涨](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/brent-wti-oil-prices-us-launches-fresh-strikes-on-iran-.html)** — 布伦特原油突破关键位，市场担心霍尔木兹海峡中断将持续更久。
- **[特朗普称“爱通胀”，分析认为沃什乐见](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/10/trump-inflation-fed-chair-kevin-warsh-analysis.html)** — 总统表示4.2%的通胀可以接受，而非必要立即打压，这给沃什的加息路径提供了政治缓冲。
- **[甲骨文财报超预期但股价跌，再融资200亿美元](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/10/oracle-orcl-q4-earnings-report-2026.html)** — 云业务增长强劲，但自由现金流转负+大规模数据中心资本开支令投资者担忧回报周期。
- **[美联储公布年度银行压力测试结果将于6月24日发布](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260609a.htm)** — 市场关注大型银行能否通过极端情景，尤其是油价暴涨对能源信贷的影响。
- **收束判断**：短期美股仍受制于地缘风险与通胀黏性，能源股可能逆势走强，但科技成长股面临估值压力，建议关注6月24日压力测试后的银行板块动向。
美股.en:
U.S. equity futures extended their slide as a fresh round of U.S. military strikes on Iran sent oil prices surging and inflation data (CPI at 4.2%) reinforced stagflation fears. The S&P 500 and Nasdaq are under pressure, with investors rotating into energy stocks while tech and growth names falter. President Trump's comment that he 'loves inflation' added to policy confusion, though markets still assume a future Iran deal will ease tensions.

- **Oil spikes as U.S. attacks Iran**: Brent crude jumped after the Pentagon confirmed strikes on 'multiple targets' in Iran. The Strait of Hormuz remains a flashpoint; analysts warn of extended disruption to global energy flows. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/11/brent-wti-oil-prices-us-launches-fresh-strikes-on-iran-.html), [NYT](https://www.nytimes.com/2026/06/10/business/oil-gas-price-iran.html))
- **Oracle (ORCL) beats but tumbles on capital raise**: Q4 earnings topped estimates but plans to raise $20B for data centers spooked investors, sending the stock lower. Free cash flow is negative. ([CNBC](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/10/oracle-orcl-q4-earnings-report-2026.html))
- **Trump's 'love inflation' comment rattles bond markets**: The president signaled comfort with 4.2% inflation, which could embolden the Fed to stay hawkish. New Fed Chair Kevin Warsh may see this as cover for further tightening. ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/10/inflation-report-rate), [CNBC analysis](https://www.cnbc.com/2026/06/10/trump-inflation-fed-chair-kevin-warsh-analysis.html))
- **Fed stress test results due June 24**: The Federal Reserve announced that its annual bank stress test results will be released on June 24 at 4 p.m. EDT, a key event for bank stocks. ([Federal Reserve](https://www.federalreserve.gov/newsevents/pressreleases/bcreg20260609a.htm))

The risk-off tone is likely to persist until there is clarity on Iran de-escalation. Watch for any statement from the White House on a possible deal, and the SpaceX IPO on Friday which could redirect capital flows.

欧洲经济.zh:
**欧洲经济：能源冲击叠加央行加息预期，股市多数收跌**

欧股周四普遍走低，美伊紧张推升能源进口成本，而欧洲央行即将在利率决议中面临“两难选择”：加息抑制通胀 vs 抑制经济增长。央行官员Elderson接受采访暗示需谨慎，市场则定价ECB将小幅加息。
- **[欧洲股市收盘多数下跌，ECB展望与美伊冲突施压](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxNUElaRC1iV2QxcGRickFtaldTLWtPd3VrRTRBUHBWaFQxOWxoaG43a2hTdUhOREFrOVBqZ0xxN3BSSk8wWTJZUElwTjFoeGZ1UEJmdVlnME5INnFtc0JPRzl5MGR5eXctdklla1RuVUJSTGc1MVF6WWRKOC02VmNuLTVxR05nY0dJMGRGemdEdVFIc3pHWEFhUTM0MzRWTGZSR0g2RmdYQ2ZSLUwxOXVURHV5VUZIM0pnRzhiS3I4ZFBwMVk)** — 泛欧斯托克600指数收跌，能源和旅游板块领跌。
- **[ECB与BoE面临“两个可能的错误”](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQSjBpN0FicHB4bXhNeFJ6ZVdINGVBaUZmd2xTME1vd0R3UU5pWTZVSWJNWXp5LW1fbGRCSXFGQzRaMk1kTUd0emMwZlpuNkk0NHg4MUhrMDF2R282WVJIUGhqeGNZd0J6bEx4ZS15S055MEFDUkQxeldnZEp1UjR3SDhLMXI2QkNOU05Z)** — Politico分析指出，央行若过度加息可能扼杀增长，若不行动则通胀预期脱锚，伊朗战争让这一权衡更加困难。
- **[欧洲央行发布欧元国际角色报告](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxOLV9pMkt3U2JVclZ5NnpuYTNLdlo2c2JMTVlYU2pmM1NBWVR3UVotbkhUQ1VIX1lMX1ZYdGNQeWxXbGk0MmxiVmdqVGcwMDE0Vk8wLURGWlcxVHl1YjVLcVY2U01fb0I0VzQzcDVjbHNDZ3JxYXdvclF5WUZETlRWZ1RXaHNURmh0)** — 在全球地缘风险上升之际，欧元作为储备货币的地位受到能源危机挑战。
- **[BYD目标五年内成为全球最大车企，计划在欧洲投建快充设施](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/10/china-byd-car-firm-ev-maker-toyota)** — 中国电动车巨头宣布将投入18亿英镑在欧洲建设5分钟快充网络，直接挑战传统车企。
- **收束判断**：ECB若在6月会议上加息，将进一步压制欧洲需求，但能源冲击下通胀难降，欧洲可能陷入“滞胀”困境，投资者需关注该行对经济前景的最新预测。
欧洲经济.en:
European stocks closed mostly lower as escalating U.S.-Iran tensions and higher oil prices weighed on sentiment, ahead of the ECB's June rate decision. The ECB is widely expected to deliver a cautious hike, balancing rising energy-driven inflation against a fragile eurozone economy. The euro's international role report and the Circular Economy Act were also in focus.

- **ECB rate decision looms**: The ECB faces a 'cautious hike in a fragile landscape' as energy prices take center stage. Policymakers weigh the risk of over-tightening versus the need to anchor inflation expectations. ([RankiaPro](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMinwFBVV95cUxNMHNHODFwMTJxRFF1T0M4UkFyYzFTR0ExUUVETnRLX0V6TWlJeGVoMHJOMlhHanJoTV84UTg2TnpKQWJld3R3R1h2dC1tdFpQOWR1SzFSMVd2cXdFbGxGYTB3Z2dvTTJlRmpqYzdXRzFlNEJuS3VSSnVVLTJjN2xxTTdKT09lbDB1cU5NeWp2NG1KSHZsTFU3X2ZNVWZGQjQ), [Politico](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiwFBVV95cUxQSjBpN0FicHB4XmhNeFJ6ZVdINGVBaUZmd2xTME1vd0R3UU5pWTZVSWJNWXp5LW1fbGRCSXFGQzRaMk1kTUd0emMwZlpuNkk0NHg4MUhrMDF2R282WVJIUGhqeGNZd0J6bEx4ZS15S055MEFDUkQxeldnZEp1UjR3SDhLMXI2QkNOU05Z))
- **Eurozone markets slide on risk-off**: European stocks closed mostly lower as U.S.-Iran jitters and the ECB outlook weighed. Defensive sectors outperformed. ([Anadolu Ajansı](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiwwFBVV95cUxNUElaRC1iV2QxcGRickFtaldTLWtPd3VrRTRBUHBWaFQxOWxoaG43a2hTdUhOREFrOVBqZ0xxN3BSSk8wWTJZUElwTjFoeGZ1UEJmdVlnME5INnFtc0JPRzl5MGR5eXctdklla1RuVUJSTGc1MVF6WWRKOC02VmNuLTVxR05nY0dJMGRGemdEdVFIc3pHWEFhUTM0MzRWTGZSR0g2RmdYQ2ZSLUwxOXVURHV5VUZIM0pnRzhiS3I4ZFBwMVk))
- **ECB's Frank Elderson interviewed**: An ECB board member spoke to Dutch newspaper Het Financieele Dagblad, offering insights into the bank's thinking ahead of the rate decision. ([ECB](https://www.ecb.europa.eu//press/inter/date/2026/html/ecb.in260610~439aa97519.en.html))
- **BYD targets Europe with flash chargers**: The Chinese EV maker plans to spend £1.8bn to build five-minute flash chargers in Europe, signaling aggressive expansion. ([The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/10/china-byd-car-firm-ev-maker-toyota))
- **Space ETF market expands in Europe**: BlackRock joined the European space ETF expansion, reflecting growing investor interest in the sector. ([Pensions & Investments](https://news.google.))

The ECB decision on Thursday will set the tone for European markets. If the bank signals further hikes due to energy-driven inflation, it could pressure bonds and growth stocks. Watch for comments on the euro's international role and the impact of the Iran war on European energy imports.

中国经济.zh:
**中国经济：地缘避险拖累股市，比亚迪逆势崛起**

沪深港股市全面低开，美伊冲突压制风险偏好，但结构性亮点突出：比亚迪受油价暴涨刺激电动车需求，重回国内汽车销冠；AI板块则因泡沫警示而承压。香港债务市场活跃，腾讯和太古合计融资超52亿美元，显示离岸人民币枢纽功能强化。
- **[比亚迪超越吉利，能源危机加速电动车渗透](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356667/byd-powers-past-geely-oil-shock-charges-global-ev-demand)** — 比亚迪4-5月销量强劲，Q2反超吉利成为国内最大车企，全球战略目标直指丰田。
- **[AI交易发出dot-com式警告](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356617/global-ai-trade-flashing-signals-reminiscent-dotcom-bust-analysts-warn)** — 美银报告指出AI估值分化已达极端水平，叠加SpaceX等巨量IPO，全球科技股面临回调风险，中国AI概念股亦受拖累。
- **[香港债务市场火爆，腾讯太古融资52亿美元](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3356591/hong-kong-debt-market-heats-tencent-swire-raise-us52b-multi-currency-deals)** — 多币种债券发行凸显香港作为国际债券枢纽的地位，美中利差与地缘不确定性推动企业提前锁定低成本资金。
- **[哈萨克斯坦银行借道香港拓展离岸人民币业务](https://news.google.)** — 哈萨克斯坦银行通过香港发行离岸人民币债，反映“一带一路”沿线国家对人民币融资的需求上升。
- **收束判断**：短期A股和港股受地缘情绪压制，但能源危机催化下的电动车产业链（比亚迪、锂电）以及受益于人民币国际化的香港金融股存在结构性机会，关注下周MLF续作信号。
中国经济.en:
China and Hong Kong stocks fell on Thursday as escalating Gulf tensions triggered a regional risk-off tone, though oil-related stocks and mainland banks firmed. The Hang Seng Index slipped 0.66% to 24,244. Meanwhile, BYD regained momentum as the global energy crisis boosted EV demand, and Hong Kong's debt market saw a surge with Tencent and Swire raising US$5.2 billion in multi-currency bonds. The AI trade is also under scrutiny as analysts warn of dotcom-era froth.

- **BYD powers past Geely on oil shock**: BYD reclaimed pole position in China's auto sector as the global energy crisis accelerated EV demand. BYD plans to overtake Toyota within five years and is investing heavily in European charging infrastructure. ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356667/byd-powers-past-geely-oil-shock-charges-global-ev-demand), [The Guardian](https://www.theguardian.com/business/2026/jun/10/china-byd-car-firm-ev-maker-toyota))
- **Hong Kong debt market heats up**: Tencent and Swire Pacific raised over US$5.2 billion in multi-currency bond deals (USD, offshore CNY, HKD), underscoring Hong Kong's role as an international bond hub. ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/banking-finance/article/3356591/hong-kong-debt-market-heats-tencent-swire-raise-us52b-multi-currency-deals))
- **Global AI trade triggers dotcom-era warnings**: Bank of America notes that the valuation gap between AI winners and laggards is as wide as before the 2000 bust. The pace of IPOs is accelerating, reminiscent of the bubble. ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/business/china-business/article/3356617/global-ai-trade-flashing-signals-reminiscent-dotcom-bust-analysts-warn), [SCMP](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiywFBVV95cUxORE52Ym8wb25FbFVONU1pcGJfZ0o2WDB4dlNWeFNmRG9oZTV6Y0Y4b0hlYUY5TUNmWGNuRVdKMVhUZmxzbGtpa09FU3FSdDhHSXpiamVjRzBuZFltbl9yZEh3TTE0RWdreFY3bUJfYTViUjE2YVU1M3JET0VDMXRvQWdLVEp4UjFXR0hEWEd0NGZIbXJ5RTI5Qk4zOXVXVlgzbmxNYnkxd3E2ZkNTSzFpWDdDQmFpX09jWVRVWTRadktlTlZ2SFFhb3ZKcw))
- **Pinglu Canal trial operations set for September**: The landmark waterway project, which could reshape trade routes, is drawing significant international attention, particularly from the US and Singapore. ([SCMP](https://www.scmp.com/opinion/hong-kong-opinion/article/3355865/why-hong-kong-should-be-very-interested-pinglu-canal))
- **Cross-border securities rectification**: China is cracking down on illegal cross-border securities investments, with implications for capital flows into and out of the mainland. ([Eurasia Review](https://news.google.))

The key risk for China is the dual impact of higher oil prices (import cost) and global risk aversion. However, BYD's surge and Hong Kong's bond market strength show pockets of resilience. Watch for any PBOC policy response to the oil shock and the SpaceX IPO's influence on Chinese investor sentiment.

同花顺社区动态.zh:
**同花顺社区：资金在避险与题材间剧烈切换**

今日社区热议三个方向：央行逆回购操作维持流动性平稳；沪金突然闪崩反映加息预期骤升；中字头股票涨停说明资金依然有抱团高股息意愿。个股方面，长安汽车澄清“四折出售”传闻，力量钻石投建新材料项目涨停。

- **[长安汽车回应“四折出售”传闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiYkFVX3lxTFBsSnMxdC1Dd09KRVJzNEcwLWV4bzRwNy1iamcwQTlzZF9mR3dfOTliLWRqMTE3TnlSWFpyUm0tTzdEZXpSWWppYXpKcVdnNllNQ3A0U3hfZ1luV2FWa0hwNmVB)** — 挂牌转让长安福特新能源40%股权为正常结构调整，并非折价出售，社区情绪有所平复。
- **[7000亿光模块龙头筹划赴港上市](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiXkFVX3lxTFBiOFROcUNYVjlvQmdJOHlvNFFVT0d3UDFkd282TnJGTG1HMTE1R3RCc3dKajRuXzgxSFVpcmhJTHhDam9UVWxLempjeEVQa09DMUQ0aXZiUlJ1OEtBYXc)** — 中际旭创（或对应公司）计划H股上市，社区讨论“AI算力赛道是否还能追高”。
- **收束判断**：社区情绪呈现“避险-成长”两极分化，黄金闪崩与中字头涨停形成鲜明对比，短期建议关注央行逆回购动态与地缘事件进展，控制仓位，避免追涨杀跌。

中东战事成为绝对主线：美国中央司令部6月10日对伊朗发动新一轮打击，目标涉及多个地点；伊朗随即宣布关闭霍尔木兹海峡，禁止所有船只通行，全球油价应声波动。与此同时，乌克兰战场出现新变化——地面无人驾驶战车开始承担一线任务，士兵无人机技能竞赛凸显战术革新。欧洲方面，法国著名歌手Patrick Bruel被控强奸并进入司法调查；比尔·盖茨在国会闭门听证中承认爱泼斯坦曾试图利用其婚外情进行要挟。此外，澳大利亚自由党内部因是否与One Nation合作产生分裂。

- **Ukraine relies on ground-based drones for frontline combat** as robotic warfare reshapes the battlefield — a competition tests soldiers' drone skills. 知乎社区动态.en:
Zhihu community discussions are currently focused on the intersection of content platforms and AI, with Zhihu's own financial struggles and pivot to AI highlighting broader industry trends. Entertainment gossip and niche scandals also drive engagement.

冲突局势.zh:
过去24小时，美伊冲突从“打代理人”直接升级为“面对面”交火。美国因一架阿帕奇直升机被击落而打击伊朗本土，伊朗革命卫队则用无人机和导弹攻击驻巴林的美国第五舰队及驻约旦目标，双方均未退让。俄罗斯方面，普京拒绝泽连斯基的和谈提议，乌克兰则用远程武器打击俄境内军事和能源设施。瑞典宣布向乌克兰提供16架鹰狮战斗机，这将是乌军首次拥有西方先进战机。土耳其悄悄转向北约的信号值得关注。

**收束判断**：美伊冲突的升级使中东停火形同虚设，后续48小时是决定全面战争还是重回谈判的关键窗口。
冲突局势.en:
The U.S.-Iran ceasefire collapsed completely as both sides launched direct strikes. The conflict threatens to broaden into a region-wide war involving Gulf states and Israel. Meanwhile, the Russia-Ukraine war continues to intensify with new weapons pledges and rejected diplomacy.

- **Iran strikes U.S. Fifth Fleet in Bahrain**: The IRGC launched a [drone attack on America's Gulf Command](https://news.google.) in retaliation for U.S. strikes. The attack targeted the Fifth Fleet, marking a dangerous direct engagement with U.S. naval forces.
- **U.S. strikes Iran for second consecutive day**: After downing an Apache helicopter, the U.S. conducted [airstrikes on southern Iran](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNT1NCUi1ER19KYTBHTk80MkdYQjBxSUlJTUpKU3hNejFxZ09SYWZYV1llVlJVWlhuZUhWRENyeHpJbG5ILV9hNTN5Wi1rR1YyWm5ub2xWY2Q4dEtHMkEwVVo3V2dRSjU2R1Z2dE1oSlpBSUluOTQxdjFpUWF3ZTBhWElCVzg0LUFf). The strikes continued [into a second day](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMihgFBVV95cUxOdmo0X3FrOGRCRUF4VVlxTjdTM3RhcVN2TkFmdjhTLUVvMDlubDJDTktCWC1DQ2Z2TlJnYjFhSlF4bEsyMElpQi1RRVk2WUtQdGpYOXd2VFdDUVdrVDd6SGVhWnFxM3hoYzgtQ3hVUkRJenlqVHI1R3dDMFVTWlh0RTI5ZVBEZw), escalating beyond initial retaliation.
- **Putin rejects Zelenskyy’s talks offer**: As the Ukraine war intensifies, [Putin refused negotiations](https://news.google.) while Ukraine launched long-range strikes against Russian military and energy sites.
- **Suez Canal traffic surges despite Red Sea risks**: Maritime traffic through the Suez Canal is rising again as [Hormuz Strait tensions also reignite](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiVEFVX3lxTFBDdTkwajBzNElvRko1OC01eWZiQkxlM05zU3g1c1ZPY0ZMczhaMkJaY1p1dUtNOGpKa1F0M2NaQnBMUGRYTGtCdXh2T2IzdTZBTEdvbg), suggesting shippers are recalibrating risk calculations despite ongoing conflicts.

**Signal**: The U.S.-Iran conflict is now a direct kinetic exchange—expect further retaliation, possible Israeli involvement, and disruption to global energy routes via Hormuz.

国际安全.zh:
美伊冲突是今日国际安全的最大变量，一夜之间，4月8日以来的停火协议被打破。美国对伊朗实施连续空袭，伊朗反击打到了巴林和约旦。与此同时，台湾首次用美制攻击无人机打击海上目标，验证了非对称战力的实战化。欧洲方面，德国展示“眼镜蛇600”拦截无人机，波音推出第三版“幽灵蝙蝠”可内挂导弹，美国众院公布万亿国防预算案。海上无人艇在伊朗附近完成直升机救援，凸显无人系统价值。

- [Taiwanese Forces Deploy American-made Attack Drones (USNI News)](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/taiwanese-forces-deploy-american-made-attack-drones-against-maritime-targets)

**收束判断**：美伊冲突风险外溢，波罗的海及印太难再获资源支持；无人系统在台海和中东的实战化测试正在加速各国军备采购策略。
国际安全.en:
The breakdown of the U.S.-Iran ceasefire dominates the international security landscape, with Israel preparing for missile attacks and the U.S. House moving a massive defense bill. New drone and hypersonic systems are reshaping deterrence postures globally.

- **Israel braces for Iranian missiles**: After U.S. strikes across Iran, [Israel is on high alert for incoming missiles](https://news.google.). This raises the risk of a multi-front conflagration involving Hezbollah and other Iranian proxies.
- **Sweden sends 16 Gripen jets to Ukraine**: The [Gripen pledge](https://news.google.) with 200-km-range missiles will significantly enhance Ukraine’s strike capability and force Russia to redeploy air defenses. This is one of the largest Western fighter transfers to date.
- **Taiwan deploys American attack drones against maritime targets**: In a first, Taiwan used [U.S.-supplied attack drones](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMirgFBVV95cUxNV0hfLWZhZzdRcWRqRkVvNFZVX0FzUVFfN3BRZF9Zcl8zalI3U2kxd2thcVp4MXlQTzN5VDRqaFRLakVrWW9ZLWpJb1RHRGF0MEVQSE0yRGExSlZZWnV3T3VQa0szcjVCT1ZIS1VFT19OdW4tMk1TdFFvY3IyTlNrZHl2RzV1M0hOS2RVRmZVMzlPYi1KblFpcF9vRldBZlNlUy1KbWJRR01EdmxKaHc) in live-fire drills targeting maritime targets, validating its anti-invasion strategy with unmanned systems.
- **Germany unveils Cobra 600 jet-powered interceptor drone**: The [Cobra 600](https://www.twz.com/air/germanys-cobra-600-is-a-jet-powered-interceptor-drone-that-slings-an-iris-t-missile) can carry an IRIS-T missile hundreds of miles from its launch point, extending surface-to-air missile coverage and offering a new layer of air defense.
- **House appropriators release $1 trillion FY27 defense bill**: The [bill](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxNVnVYeEFqcnJYUVZZbk9JbmwyTUxuT3pFSlVDSVpENW5rS2VNSGRwcV9VcFl0alFqdUFDRVVOR3lHMm0zZjdYamdiei1xVDVKZmxwcFNPRUU2c0JuemNtanFmOGRfb0lGQUVMRUxGd09IRV95cFR5TkZ3YjRxOVVraHRrdnQ4bW9xcHFqNFloaFJKeXhZdTVueEFUUllrZw) explicitly targets China as the principal strategic competitor and pushes for supply chain decoupling from Beijing.

**Signal**: The convergence of direct U.S.-Iran strikes, advanced weapons transfers to Ukraine, and Asian drone/hypersonic programs signals a global acceleration in the arms race and a shift to unmanned, long-range precision warfare.

海军与印太.zh:
台海方向，台湾首次使用美制攻击无人机在实弹演习中打击海上目标，标志着其非对称打击能力从理论走向实战。美国下一代“哥伦比亚级”核潜艇艇体分段曝光，展示了X型尾舵等先进设计。北约BALTOPS 2026演习在波罗的海启动，但规模因中东局势缩减。日本与韩国在时隔九年后恢复联合海上搜救演习，表明两国军事合作回暖。葡萄牙海军通过北约采购47座遥控武器站，强化近海防御。

- [Taiwanese Forces Deploy American-made Attack Drones (USNI News)](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/taiwanese-forces-deploy-american-made-attack-drones-against-maritime-targets)
- [New Look at America’s Next Ballistic Missile Submarine (Naval News)](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/new-look-at-americas-next-ballistic-missile-submarine/)
- [BALTOPS 2026 Exercise Begins (USNI News)](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/baltops-2026-exercise-begins)
- [Japan And South Korea Resume SAREX (Naval News)](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/japan-and-south-korea-resume-sarex-after-nine-year-hiatus/)
- [EM&E to Supply 47 Remote Weapon Stations (Naval News)](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/eme-to-supply-47-remote-weapon-stations-to-portuguese-navy/)

**收束判断**：台湾无人机实弹测试将加大解放军反制压力；美日韩海军合作若持续，可能改变西太平洋兵力部署态势。
海军与印太.en:
Naval dynamics in the Indo-Pacific and beyond are shifting: Taiwan tests attack drones against maritime targets, NATO’s BALTOPS proceeds with reduced forces, Japan and South Korea renew bilateral drills, and the U.S. pushes ahead with its next ballistic missile submarine.

- **Taiwanese forces strike maritime targets with U.S. attack drones**: During [live-fire drills](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/taiwanese-forces-deploy-american-made-attack-drones-against-maritime-targets), Taiwan’s newly acquired American drones hit offshore targets, demonstrating a key capability for anti-invasion operations. The exercise validates long-range strike concepts that would be critical in a Taiwan Strait crisis.
- **BALTOPS 2026 begins with fewer ships due to Middle East commitments**: NATO’s [Baltic Operations exercise](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/baltops-2026-exercise-begins) includes 20 ships and 6,000 personnel from 15 allies, down from 2025 because naval assets are diverted to the Middle East. For the first time since 1972, the exercise is commanded from JFC Brunssum, reflecting NATO’s evolving command structure.
- **New images of USS District of Columbia (SSBN-826) emerge**: Photos of the [next-generation ballistic missile submarine](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/new-look-at-americas-next-ballistic-missile-submarine/) show progress on the bow and stern sections, including the X-shaped rudder. The Columbia class is critical to maintaining U.S. strategic deterrence.
- **Japan and South Korea resume SAREX after nine-year hiatus**: The [Japan Maritime SDF and ROK Navy](https://www.navalnews.com/naval-news/2026/06/japan-and-south-korea-resume-sarex-after-nine-year-hiatus/) conducted a search-and-rescue exercise west of Japan’s Goto Islands on June 7. This thaw in military cooperation is significant given historical tensions and shared security concerns over North Korea and China.
- **Fatal shooting aboard USS John F. Kennedy (CVN-79)**: Two sailors involved in the [shooting](https://news.usni.org/2026/06/10/sailors-involved-in-jfk-shooting-were-part-of-carriers-in-port-security-force) were part of the carrier’s in-port security force. One sailor was killed; the other is in pretrial confinement. The incident raises questions about security protocols on new construction vessels.

**Signal**: The Indo-Pacific maritime domain is seeing intensified drills and capability demonstrations, even as NATO navies are stretched by Middle Eastern commitments. Taiwan’s drone integration is a bellwether for future littoral combat.

中国军情.zh:
今日中国军情聚焦外交摩擦与供应链安全。中国外交部批驳日本对中国正常军事活动的指责，称其“刻意渲染紧张”。美国会委员会在2027国防授权法中明确将中国列为主要战略对手，并扩大“中国军工企业”清单，将比亚迪、宇树科技等新增入列，蔚来汽车公开反驳。捷克国防部紧随美国，限制中国汽车进入军事区域。此外，有专家就西太平洋局势发出“暗流涌动”的警示。
