- [美国扩大“中国军企”清单 比亚迪、宇树皆入列 (dw.com)](https://news.google.)
- [蔚来汽车反驳被美列入中国军工企业名单 (汽车之家)](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE45VzVtQUhjbWZva3RlNVdLVXNlWWp0bUx5WDJnVW1EM3BTNEpfTEYyT0MwMWFTV25RbG1kbEsxRW9VU3lMcHJDUzRlM29qZmVsNGxoNEVzanlPeDQ)
- [捷克国防部限制中国汽车进入敏感军事区域 (RFI)](https://news.google.)

**收束判断**：美国扩大“中国军企”清单将加剧中企海外合规风险，捷克等欧洲国家的跟随动作表明供应链“去中国化”正从经济向防务领域蔓延。
中国军情.en:
China continues to face pressure from multiple directions: Japan’s criticism of its military activities, U.S. legislative and blacklist moves targeting Chinese defense and tech firms, and European restrictions on Chinese vehicles. Beijing is pushing back against what it calls ‘unfounded accusations’ while experts warn of rising tensions in the West Pacific.

- **Japan accuses China of ‘normal military activities’, Beijing rebuts**: The Chinese Foreign Ministry [rejected](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMicEFVX3lxTE9lXzV3dU8wbC1yNWtNQzVmaGRUNWYwem91bFhWWDgwWklRVVU5cVpwbWltTkNXUXJuQXhoMEI0Y0FUNGVGVF9ubHhCZmhxQ05UYUZOR282ajgyWDZWZE9KUmVpUVZWTURLRDRLb1VRMTE) Japanese claims that China’s military activities are destabilizing, describing them as unfounded and designed to deceive the public. This exchange underscores growing friction in East China Sea and Taiwan Strait monitoring.
- **U.S. House FY27 defense bill targets China**: The [bill](https://news.google.) names China the principal strategic competitor and includes provisions to decouple critical supply chains. It reinforces the bipartisan consensus in Washington to contain Beijing.
- **U.S. expands Chinese military-company blacklist**: [BYD, Unitree, and others](https://news.google.) were added to the Pentagon’s list of Chinese military companies. BYD quickly [rejected the designation](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE45VzVtQUhjbWZva3RlNVdLVXNlWWp0bUx5WDJnVW1EM3BTNEpfTEYyT0MwMWFTV25RbG1kbEsxRW9VU3lMcHJDUzRlM29qZmVsNGxoNEVzanlPeDQ) as baseless, highlighting the expanding scope of U.S. technology restrictions.
- **Czech Republic restricts Chinese cars near military zones**: The Czech Defense Ministry is [limiting Chinese-made vehicles](https://news.google.) from entering sensitive military areas, citing espionage risks. This follows a trend of European allies tightening restrictions on Chinese technology.
- **West Pacific ‘undercurrents’ analyzed by experts**: A Chinese [expert analysis](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiiAFBVV95cUxNaUhPM2dlMXFGc2FSWkdncXFDa0E3UkF1dDVaSVBZT3I4X21PbHAxNDF3T19MRWU2b2NOVFBCNTBLMkVHR1BxVlQzcTlHVUhub0N5UXRVWXY3Rnd0U1VZSFlLS3Z6SDM1Tkt0eVdBRlFsWUtmcmd3Ni1PRkJnQ0F4Zk45UzBVM0pU) warns that tensions in the West Pacific are at a dangerous inflection point, with the U.S., Japan, and Taiwan all pressing aggressive military postures that China views as provocations.

**Signal**: The U.S. and its allies are systematically tightening the screws on China’s defense and tech sectors, while China seeks to frame its military activities as routine. Expect further friction as the FY27 bill moves through Congress and blacklists expand.

AI.zh:
AI 安全与监管迎来密集动作。xAI 前工程师起诉公司因提出 Grok 安全问题遭解雇（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/10/xai-fired-an-engineer-who-raised-alarms-about-grok-safety-new-lawsuit-claims/)），加拿大新法案要求社交平台对 AI 聊天机器人负责（[Engadget](https://www.engadget.com/2191879/canada-announces-bill-banning-social-media-for-anyone-under-16/)），CISA 将漏洞修复窗口压缩至三天（[Wired](https://www.wired.com/story/cisa-ai-vulnerability-directive/)）。与此同时，Andrew Yang 发文呼吁“先干再说”而非等待华盛顿立法（[TechCrunch](https://techcrunch.com/video/why-andrew-yang-is-building-instead-of-waiting-for-washington/)），显示出产业界与监管层的认知鸿沟。技术层面，Google DeepMind 发布 DiffusionGemma 实现 4 倍推理加速（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/google/2026/06/googles-latest-diffusiongemma-open-ai-model-comes-with-a-4x-speed-boost/)），但 Anthropic 的 Claude Fable 5 拒绝回答基础生物问题引发可靠性质疑（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/947973/fable-wont-answer-basic-biology-questions)）。

收束判断：AI 产业正处在能力突破与合规压力的十字路口，xAI 案和加拿大法案可能加速全球 AI 责任立法进程，而模型的能力边界仍是采购和部署的主要风险点。
AI.en:
The AI desk saw a flurry of model releases and safety controversies. Google DeepMind’s DiffusionGemma offers a 4x speed boost for local AI, while Anthropic’s Mythos / Claude Fable 5 is criticized for refusing basic biology queries. A former xAI engineer is suing over safety whistleblowing, and CISA is slashing patch timelines to counter AI-augmented threats. The tension between speed and safety is at an all-time high.
- [Google DeepMind releases DiffusionGemma, a model that runs local AI 4x faster](https://arstechnica.com/google/2026/06/googles-latest-diffusiongemma-open-ai-model-comes-with-a-4x-speed-boost/) — Diffusion for text speedup; open model availability.
- [Claude Fable won’t answer basic biology questions](https://www.theverge.com/ai-artificial-intelligence/947973/fable-wont-answer-basic-biology-questions) — Hand-off to weaker model undermines claims of biology prowess.
- [xAI fired an engineer who raised alarms about Grok safety, new lawsuit claims](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/10/xai-fired-an-engineer-who-raised-alarms-about-grok-safety-new-lawsuit-claims/) — Alleged retaliation days before SpaceX IPO adds corporate governance risk.
- [CISA Tells US Agencies to Fix Security Bugs in as Little as 3 Days Thanks to AI Threats](https://www.wired.com/story/cisa-ai-vulnerability-directive/) — Signals that AI-driven cyberattacks are outpacing traditional patching cadences.

Watch for: The German court ruling that said “nobody needs AI to search the Internet” could chill AI search adoption across Europe.

科技产品.zh:
数据安全与平台策略调整成为今日焦点。Valve 因诈骗泛滥停止生产实体 Steam 礼品卡（[Ars Technica](https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/06/valve-kills-its-retail-gift-card-program-due-to-scammers/)），直接影响零售渠道和现金用户群体；近百万份护照与身份证件因某平台未加保护而在线暴露（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/947157/passports-data-breach-cannabis-club-systems-nefos-puffpal)），暴露出身份认证 API 的安全隐患。Microsoft Xbox 部门预告下月大裁员，可能涉及工作室关闭（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/games/948142/microsoft-xbox-layoffs-reset-asha-sharma)）。Bluesky 宣布将推出“社区”功能，基于 AT 协议构建去中心化社群（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/tech/948215/bluesky-communities-at-protocol-atmosphere-reddit)）。Framework Laptop 13 Pro 首批发货延迟一个月（[The Verge](https://www.theverge.com/gadgets/948044/framework-laptop-13-pro-delay-shipment-july-august)）。

收束判断：大型平台在安全、合规与成本之间艰难取舍，玩家和开发者的信任将因数据泄露与裁员潮而面临考验。
科技产品.en:
Consumer tech and enterprise security dominated the 科技产品 desk. A massive passport data breach exposed nearly a million IDs, while ShinyHunters claimed Oracle PeopleSoft breaches at 100+ organizations. Valve ended its retail Steam gift card program due to scammers, and Xbox is bracing for layoffs and a “reset.” On the positive side, Apple and Google added Thread 1.4 support, and Framework Laptop 13 Pro shipments are delayed by a month.
- [Nearly a million passports and photo IDs were left unprotected on the public internet](https://www.theverge.com/tech/947157/passports-data-breach-cannabis-club-systems-nefos-puffpal) — A journalist accessed the data by typing a few characters; highlights systemic data hygiene failures.
- [Cybercriminals claim breach of Oracle PeopleSoft servers at 100-plus organizations](https://techcrunch.com/2026/06/10/cybercriminals-claim-breach-of-oracle-peoplesoft-servers-at-100-plus-organizations/) — Universities and large enterprises exposed; ShinyHunters gang active.
- [Valve kills its retail gift card program due to scammers](https://arstechnica.com/gaming/2026/06/valve-kills-its-retail-gift-card-program-due-to-scammers/) — Ends a major legitimate cash-to-Steam gateway.
- [Xbox warns of a ‘reset’ as it prepares for layoffs](https://www.theverge.com/games/948142/microsoft-xbox-layoffs-reset-asha-sharma) — Potential studio closures; cost-cutting amid stagnant console sales.
- [Windows 11 sucks slightly less now, thanks to a June update](https://www.engadget.com/2191909/windows-11-sucks-slightly-less-now-thanks-to-a-june-update/) — Low-latency profile and faster search; patch for hundreds of flaws.

Watch for: The impact of Canada’s social media ban bill (under 16) on AI chatbot services, and whether the Kalshi prediction market regulation framework sets precedent.

汽车.zh:
比亚迪今日占据几乎所有头条。该公司威胁起诉美国防部将其列入“中国军事企业”名单，称该指控旨在阻碍其国际成功（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-threatens-sue-trump-administration-pentagon-military-list/)）。同时，比亚迪董事长称将在五年内超越丰田成为全球最大车企（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-outsold-ford-thinks-it-can-catch-toyota-for-no-1/)），并预告在加拿大部署 1500kW 的 Flash 充电网络，5 分钟补能 400 公里（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-flash-charging-canada-5-minute-ev-charging-network/)）。在北美市场，EV 销量在联邦补贴取消后仍创下今年最佳月份（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/ev-sales-just-hit-their-best-month-since-federal-tax-credits-ended/)），福特 3 万美元级电动皮卡首次被捕获（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/fords-30000-ev-pickup-spotted-in-wild-first-time/)），Kia EV2 在实测中超出官方续航 5%（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/kia-ev2-delivers-105-of-official-range-estimate-in-real-world/)）。GM 则押注钠离子电池用于储能而非电动车（[Electrek](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/gm-sodium-ion-battery-peak-energy/)）。

收束判断：比亚迪的扩张已引发中美贸易摩擦升级，其充电基础设施布局可能改变行业竞争规则；而福特、Kia 等传统车企的低价电动车表明市场仍在等待真正可负担的电动化解决方案。
汽车.en:
BYD is the undisputed star of the 汽车 desk. The Chinese giant is threatening to sue the Trump administration over a Pentagon military list, while simultaneously announcing plans to become the world’s largest automaker in five years. Its 1,500 kW Flash Charging network is coming to Canada, and it already deploys 2.4x more charging power monthly than Tesla. Other automakers are pivoting: GM is investing in sodium-ion batteries for grid storage, Ford’s $30,000 EV pickup was spotted testing, and Kia’s EV2 beat its range estimate. EV sales hit their best month since federal tax credits ended.
- [BYD threatens to sue Trump administration over Pentagon military list](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-threatens-sue-trump-administration-pentagon-military-list/) — Legal “weapons” threatened; designation could restrict US sales and supply chain.
- [BYD is bringing its 5-min ‘Flash’ electric car charging to Canada](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-flash-charging-canada-5-minute-ev-charging-network/) — First North American deployment via job posting in Toronto.
- [BYD is deploying 2.4x more charging power per month than Tesla](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/byd-coming-for-tesla-supercharger-network-1500-kw-flash-charging/) — Over 5,700 stations in China in months; could surpass Tesla’s global network in 2-3 years.
- [GM is betting on battery cells that don’t use lithium](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/gm-sodium-ion-battery-peak-energy/) — Sodium-ion for grid storage, not EVs; GM Ventures invests in Peak Energy.
- [EV sales just hit their best month since federal tax credits ended](https://electrek.co/2026/06/10/ev-sales-just-hit-their-best-month-since-federal-tax-credits-ended/) — May 2026 sales surged as prices slid; consumer demand resilient without subsidy.

Watch for: Ford’s low-cost EV pickup launch timeline and whether BYD’s legal fight with the Pentagon escalates to tariffs or sanctions.

HackNews社区动态.zh:
社区今日呈现出技术创意与资源质疑并存的局面。最热门的项目 πFS 声称可将任意文件编码到 π 的无理数序列中，引发对存储极限的奇思妙想（[GitHub](https://github.com/philipl/pifs)）。与此形成对比的是，Claude Desktop 被曝每次启动都生成 1.8GB Hyper-V 虚拟机，即便仅用于聊天也被用户批评为资源浪费（[GitHub](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/29045)）。一则伦理新闻引发 400 多点赞：农民捐赠土地用于建公园，市政府却转手卖给数据中心开发商，获利 1000 万美元（[Tom's Hardware](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/farmer-donates-land-for-a-park-city-sells-it-for-data-center-development-usd10-gift-became-usd10m-for-city-government-with-usd30m-tax-expected-over-next-decade)）。此外，Cherokee 书面语言的发明故事被重新挖掘（[Smithsonian](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/innovation/man-created-written-language-cherokee-did-efficiently-elegantly-peers-thought-magic-180988850/)）。

收束判断：社区对技术浪费和城市治理的批判情绪浓厚，πFS 的创意虽不可实用却反映了程序员对怪奇技术的永恒热情。
HackNews社区动态.en:
Hacker News is buzzing with technical deep dives and community discourse. A GitHub issue revealed that Anthropic’s Claude Desktop spawns a 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, sparking debate about AI bloat. The top-voted story is πFS, a storage system that uses π’s digit sequence. A farmer’s donated land being sold for a data center (worth $10M) drew outrage over municipal priorities. Also popular: the Cherokee written language designed for efficiency, and the Raspberry Pi 5 16GB model announcement.
- [Claude Desktop spawns 1.8 GB Hyper-V VM on every launch, even for chat-only use](https://github.com/anthropics/claude-code/issues/29045) — 348 points, 243 comments; users criticize resource waste and security implications.
- [πFS](https://github.com/philipl/pifs) — 525 points; a novelty filesystem storing data in π’s digits—conceptual but not practical.
- [Farmer donates land for a park, city sells it for $10M as data center land](https://www.tomshardware.com/tech-industry/farmer-donates-land-for-a-park-city-sells-it-for-data-center-development-usd10-gift-became-usd10m-for-city-government-with-usd30m-tax-expected-over-next-decade) — 416 points; highlights trade-offs between public green space and tax revenue from AI data centers.
- [A Written Language for the Cherokee So Efficient It Was Thought to Be Magic](https://www.smithsonianmag.com/innovation/man-created-written-language-cherokee-did-efficiently-elegantly-peers-thought-magic-180988850/) — 95 points; cultural and linguistic history resonates with tech community.

Watch for: Continued debate on AI infrastructure bloat as Claude Desktop issue gains traction, and potential policy reactions to data-center land use conflicts.

足球.zh:
**英格兰临战波折，FIFA领导力遭质疑；转会窗皇马双线操作。**
- 英格兰与哥斯达黎加的热身赛因暴雨延迟，是否暗示世界杯期间极端天气预案不足？[BBC分析](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cr47lp04n34o)
- 因凡蒂诺面对索马里裁判被拒入境仅回应‘chill, relax’，被批评未维护赛事权威，[Sky Sports](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13552857/world-cup-2026-fifa-president-gianni-infantino-says-chill-and-relax-after-somali-referee-denied-us-visa)。
- 皇马1.5亿欧元报价阿尔瓦雷斯遭马竞拒绝，马竞立场强硬，[虎扑转载](https://news.google.)。
- 邓弗里斯2000万欧加盟皇马签约至2030年，罗马诺确认，[虎扑](https://news.google.)。
- 基兰·麦肯纳因家庭原因辞去伊普斯维奇主帅职位，英超征程生变，[BBC](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cd7wn0erlvwo)。

转会市场皇马攻势凌厉，但马竞拒绝放人显示德比对手的强硬；世界杯前FIFA的公信力正接受考验。
足球.en:
The football world is consumed by England's World Cup preparations and off-field controversies. Thomas Tuchel faces key decisions on Jude Bellingham's role and Bukayo Saka's start as the squad finalizes for Croatia. Gianni Infantino's dismissal of the Somali referee visa denial as 'chill, relax' has drawn sharp criticism, while Kieran McKenna's sudden resignation from Ipswich Town adds surprise managerial movement. The Scott McTominay profile reveals a player transformed at Napoli and Scotland.

- [Bellingham at number 10? Will Saka start? It's decision time for Tuchel](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cz9lxld1892o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC Sport on England's lineup dilemma.
- [Infantino could have stood up for the World Cup - but he said 'chill, relax'](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cvgj40vymlyo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC Sport analysis of FIFA's leadership crisis.
- [Family time, not Fulham time - McKenna leaves Ipswich](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cd7wn0erlvwo?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — BBC Sport on the shock departure.
- [Scotland's Super Mario and social butterfly who emerged from Man Utd cocoon](https://www.bbc.com/sport/football/articles/cx2jd7knx15o?at_medium=RSS&at_campaign=rss) — Feature on Scott McTominay's renaissance.
- [Are England now ready to go and win the World Cup?](https://www.skysports.com/football/news/12040/13552812/world-cup-england-win-final-warm-up-against-costa-rica-so-are-they-ready-to-challenge-for-tournament-glory) — Sky Sports assesses the team's form after the Costa Rica win.

With England's opener against Croatia approaching, the focus will be on Tuchel's tactical choices and the team's ability to handle high expectations.

虎扑社区动态.zh:
**跨圈争议与重磅转会齐飞，虎扑用户情绪高涨。**
- 孙颖莎与梅西、C罗、库里等一同入选权威榜单，引发虎扑男“破防”讨论，[链接](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8yRDQxT3BnVWFDcWdwcElrWWxDbmRBTlBVcHhmX0tzVmE0aGpBVW1ZUm5mb1pmYk9SVTZNWDhSRlVlc1QxS01VbEZkdHFTd1dFczh6SzczYUZLamZueUZwMEJkVQ)。
- 勒沃库森支付800-900万欧解约金签下艾希霍恩，德天空消息，[MSN](https://news.google.)。
- 皇马1.5亿报价阿尔瓦雷斯被马竞拒绝，引发“同城死敌”转会战热议，[MSN](https://news.google.)。
- 米切尔评价哈登“表情看不出表现”，NBA季后赛心态话题火爆，[MSN](https://news.google.)。
- 凯恩20秒闪击创欧冠淘汰赛下半场第二快进球纪录，拜仁球迷狂欢，[MSN](https://news.google.)。

虎扑社区今日“破圈”话题频出，体育迷的争论焦点从赛场延伸到榜单和转会博弈。
虎扑社区动态.en:
The Chinese sports community on Hupu is abuzz with a mix of international soccer transfers, NBA playoff nostalgia, and a viral list featuring Sun Yingsha alongside global icons like Messi and LeBron. Key transfer rumors include Real Madrid's failed €150m bid for Julian Alvarez and Dumfries' move to Real Madrid for €20m. NBA content includes Mitchell's comments on Harden's demeanor and historic rookie scoring lists.

- [梅西、C罗、库里、詹姆斯、Faker、大谷翔平…… 咋办，虎扑男看到自己的偶像们和孙颖莎一起入选这么权威的榜单](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE8yRDQxT3BnVWFDcWdwcElrWWxDbmRBTlBVcHhmX0tzVmE0aGpBVW1ZUm5mb1pmYk9SVTZNWDhSRlVlc1QxS01VbEZkdHFTd1dFczh6SzczYUZLamZueUZwMEJkVQ) — Hupu users react to Sun Yingsha's selection.
- [皇马官方：正式报价1.5亿求购阿尔瓦雷斯， 但马竞拒绝了报价](https://news.google.) — Real Madrid's failed Alvarez bid.
- [罗马诺：邓弗里斯已与皇马签约至2030年，转会费2000 万欧](https://news.google.) — Dumfries to Real Madrid confirmed.
- [米切尔：如果你观察哈登的表情， 你根本看不出他打的如何](https://news.google.) — Mitchell's insight on Harden's poker face.
- [76年以来新秀球员当届季后赛总得分排行：塔图姆351 分居首](https://news.google.) — Tatum tops rookie playoff scoring list since 1976.

Expect continued Hupu debates over athlete rankings and transfer sagas as the summer window heats up.

羽毛球.zh:
**安洗莹创造历史，国羽澳洲赛首轮稳健。**
- 安洗莹成为史上首位生涯奖金突破300万美元的羽毛球女单选手，世界羽联官方认证，[搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxORmhldm4yeG5qVXp5cXJRNU5JSUxMdXVnNWtla0ZEVGJOQS1BSmhQbHpLZ3BYUjh0SVY1bXBBeWtBN0p3blhlM1hDUnNsOEIzZHZRSThEYVdoTkxxX2l6Q3NDUnVKUDc2OUlONlhheG5QLTAyYWRtaUUzVDFQaEV2Q2tGTmxOb0hfSnJteQ)。
- 石宇奇与奈良冈功大在年终总决赛小组赛上演拉锯战，引发球迷“燃爆”讨论，[视频](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1rY1JFamJsS2I1Ul9pUXdoc2Itd1pndm0xMjY3TzZqVDVzNEtZOWxMeXBGZ214dFpZUkZucFN1OHZUb2hOTkRuR1dTVnVaWEVyaWFqRDhKWmVYNkE)。
- 2026年澳大利亚公开赛首轮，国羽12战9胜，“凤凰”组合冯彦哲/黄东萍、“梁王”组合梁伟铿/王昶均完胜晋级，[奥运会官网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOT0Iwa1ByOE50cTJyODdTdDRQak5pRHNyM3J6cjk5YmIyNkJ0OENTLVpiZEtLb1czQ3RkRWFHbWprV2RSM0NEOEJQbnp3WGhJSnhKbkRDQVI1N25tSkYwU3pNcEdXZktJNThzandSM20zTXNmTlpmRUd0VmlqNDg4bG1pMV80a0NhR042R242TXBSY3M1cll6dDg2NkcxZw)。
- 万锦选手赖浩俊夺得印尼公开赛超级1000冠军，创下历史，[无忧资讯](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTFAyWVZTRXFiNVpJVDRTQVVWZEozdU83T2cySVpXUmt6TUVMS2k2R3FWcnZlXzJWT1ZFb0xDYWRvMDJpTlZzdE1lR3lVMA)。

安洗莹的奖金里程碑凸显羽毛球商业化进步，国羽在澳洲赛的强势表现则为新周期注入信心。
羽毛球.en:
Badminton highlights include An Se-young's historic prize money milestone, Chinese success at the Australian Open first round, and a Canadian player's breakthrough at the Indonesia Open. An Se-young becomes the first shuttler to earn over $3 million in career prize money, recognized by the BWF. The Australian Open sees Chinese pairs and singles players secure nine wins out of twelve, with 'Fenghuang' and 'Liang Wang' advancing.

- [历史第一人！安洗莹生涯奖金突破300万美元，获世界羽联官方认证](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxORmhldm4yeG5qVXp5cXJRNU5JSUxMdXVnNWtla0ZEVGJOQS1BSmhQbHpLZ3BYUjh0SVY1bXBBeWtBN0p3blhlM1hDUnNsOEIzZHZRSThEYVdoTkxxX2l6Q3NDUnVKUDc2OUlONlhheG5QLTAyYWRtaUUzVDFQaEV2Q2tGTmxOb0hfSnJteQ) — An Se-young's $3 million milestone.
- [2026年澳大利亚羽毛球公开赛首轮综述：“凤凰”“梁王”完胜晋级，中国队12战9胜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMingFBVV95cUxOT0Iwa1ByOE50cTJyODdTdDRQak5pRHNyM3J6cjk5YmIyNkJ0OENTLVpiZEtLb1czQ3RkRWFHbWprV2RSM0NEOEJQbnp3WGhJSnhKbkRDQVI1N25tSkYwU3pNcEdXZktJNThzandSM20zTXNmTlpmRUd0VmlqNDg4bG1pMV80a0NhR042R242TXBSY3M1cll6dDg2NkcxZw) — Australian Open first round roundup.
- [万锦羽毛球选手赖浩俊勇夺印尼公开赛超级1000 冠军，创下历史](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTFAyWVZTRXFiNVpJVDRTQVVWZEozdU83T2cySVpXUmt6TUVMS2k2R3FWcnZlXzJWT1ZFb0xDYWRvMDJpTlZzdE1lR3lVMA) — Canadian player Lai Haojun wins Indonesia Open.
- [国羽16强名单公布](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE1KVmhKOTlqS3Z1c2EtYkdLRUNyMk4wbV9Fd3Fnc2JhRXI3VE5tSEl6VWtsRVBTY1pOYnVyNGxPTmcyaTRFajQ0cFpLSmVpSGlFeTM5TFFCRWdLTXduMWY4eEN6SQ) — China's national team 16-player list released.
- [燃爆对决！Shi Yu Qi Challenge Kodai Naraoka World Tour Finals 2025 Group B](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiW0FVX3lxTE1rY1JFamJsS2I1Ul9pUXdoc2Itd1pndm0xMjY3TzZqVDVzNEtZOWxMeXBGZ214dFpZUkZucFN1OHZUb2hOTkRuR1dTVnVaWEVyaWFqRDhKWmVYNkE) — Highlights of a classic match between Shi Yuqi and Kodai Naraoka.

Follow the Australian Open as the tournament progresses and watch for An Se-young's continued dominance on the world stage.

篮球.zh:
**东契奇领罚单，男篮集训启动，沃特斯国家队退役。**
- NBA官方宣布东契奇因对裁判做不雅手势被罚款5万美元，季后赛纪律管控从严，[MSN](https://news.google.)。
- 前CBA外援沃特斯宣布从波多黎各国家队退役，结束国手生涯，[直播吧](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE1BVVFIb2NSVy1mWVFpSTNRMWpUR19fWkFpb0xaTndpTTRlc185Y2V2V05qdHdKNkJpaUc4NWhlNTFzSGVHUUdWM3RsNS1NQUp0bldYaktqb2lzR0kwSTJQZUk4N0Q4Y1gyRFdqeGRWdw)。
- 中国男篮最新集训名单由杨瀚森领衔，备战未来赛事，[新浪新闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5HYW5RQWNMYmJJSzgtbjNadTFxdlo2U081cjg5al9ib0ZSckswOTJ1eFVjZFBrOW9iSUV3dHM4SWVaZUNrcldJWWZJa24wX3B5b2RDaWVOTTZtNnhnbGNxMHMyYw)。

东契奇的罚款再次引发对球员行为管理的讨论，而中国男篮的新老交替正在加速。
篮球.en:
Basketball news is relatively quiet but includes two notable off-court items and a domestic training camp announcement. Former CBA import Waters has announced his retirement from the Puerto Rico national team. Luka Doncic was fined $50,000 by the NBA for making an obscene gesture toward a referee. Meanwhile, Chinese center Yang HanSen leads the men's national team training camp.

- [媒体人：前CBA外援沃特斯 宣布从波多黎各国家队退役](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMib0FVX3lxTE1BVVFIb2NSVy1mWVFpSTNRMWpUR19fWkFpb0xaTndpTTRlc185Y2V2V05qdHdKNkJpaUc4NWhlNTFzSGVHUUdWM3RsNS1NQUp0bldYaktqb2lzR0kwSTJQZUk4N0Q4Y1gyRFdqeGRWdw) — Waters steps down from national team.
- [NBA官方：东契奇因对裁判做不雅手势被罚款5 万美元](https://news.google.) — Doncic fined for gesture.
- [杨瀚森领衔男篮集训](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE5HYW5RQWNMYmJJSzgtbjNadTFxdlo2U081cjg5al9ib0ZSckswOTJ1eFVjZFBrOW9iSUV3dHM4SWVaZUNrcldJWWZJa24wX3B5b2RDaWVOTTZtNnhnbGNxMHMyYw) — Yang HanSen leads China men's basketball camp.

With the NBA offseason underway, further disciplinary actions and international retirements may emerge. Yang HanSen's development will be key for Chinese basketball's future.

欧美.zh:
欧美板块今日焦点集中在体育与娱乐的交叉地带，以及大佬们的“旧事重提”。NBA总决赛因泰勒·斯威夫特和特朗普双双现身而破圈，尼克斯球迷用“烧鼠尾草”抗议后者“诅咒”主队，荒诞中透出纽约文化基因。影视方面，斯皮尔伯格自曝屡次被詹姆斯·邦德剧组拒之门外，如今傲娇回应“你们请不起我”，侧面反映邦德IP选角门槛之高。此外，BIGBANG宣布31场世界巡演（[Rolling Stone报道](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bigbang-2026-world-tour-dates-1235573633/)）虽是日韩艺人，但巡演覆盖欧美主流场馆，已引发欧美媒体高度关注。

- [Taylor Swift 现身NBA总决赛](https://variety.com/2026/tv/news/taylor-swift-nba-finals-new-york-knicks-1236771748/) 支持尼克斯，与特朗普同时在场形成戏剧性对比。
- [Knicks球迷烧鼠尾草抗议特朗普“诅咒”](https://variety.com/2026/scene/news/knicks-trump-curse-fans-protest-msg-barriers-1236772041/)，将体育迷信与政治情绪混搭，成为社交媒体热门素材。
- [Spielberg揭秘邦德拒导往事](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/steven-spielberg-james-bond-movies-rejected-offer-direct-1236771411/)：“You can't afford me”金句刷屏，邦德制片方未回应。

综观欧美娱乐，流媒体与体育赛事正加速融合，名人效应从红毯延伸至球场；而邦德IP的封闭性再次被大佬吐槽，007选角改革呼声或再起。
欧美.en:
The Western entertainment desk saw a mix of superstar sports appearances, major tour announcements, and reflective industry interviews. Taylor Swift's surprise attendance at the NBA Finals became a crossover event, while Spielberg's Bond rejection comments sparked nostalgia. The labor peace in Hollywood contrasts with the creative flurry of new series and films.

- **Taylor Swift and the Knicks factor**: Swift’s presence at Game 3 of the NBA Finals, along with a star-studded roster of regulars, turned the stands into a red-carpet event. The Knicks lost that game, fueling fan superstition – some even staged a sage-burning protest outside MSG ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/scene/news/knicks-trump-curse-fans-protest-msg-barriers-1236772041/)).
- **BIGBANG’s global return**: The 31-show world stadium tour marks their first major group outing since 2015; the 20th-anniversary tour will hit all major continents ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bigbang-2026-world-tour-dates-1235573633/)).
- **Spielberg reveals Bond rejection**: On his 'Disclosure Day' press tour, the legendary director detailed how he was repeatedly turned down by Bond franchise producer Cubby Broccoli after 'Jaws'. Now, he says it's a matter of cost ([Variety](https://variety.com/2026/film/news/steven-spielberg-james-bond-movies-rejected-offer-direct-1236771411/)).
- **Mindy Kaling’s TV trilogy finale**: Her new Hulu series 'Not Suitable for Work' is the third installment loosely based on her life, completing a comedic arc that began with 'The Mindy Project' and 'Never Have I Ever' ([Deadline](https://deadline.com/2026/06/mindy-kaling-not-suitable-for-work-self-based-tv-trilogy-1236953379/)).
- **Quiet labor peace in Hollywood**: After the 2023 strikes, all major unions agreed to four-year contracts without major drama, as work availability remains tight ([THR](https://www.hollywoodreporter.com/business/business-news/why-hollywoods-2026-labor-negotiations-so-sleepy-1236618886/)).

This desk signals a rebound in live events and a maturation of stars’ public narratives – expect more celebrity appearances at sports finals and reflective interviews from aging icons.

日韩.zh:
日韩今日以K-pop巡演和剧集品牌价值榜为主。BIGBANG宣布20周年31场世界巡演（[Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bigbang-2026-world-tour-dates-1235573633/)）是最大爆点——三人组（G-Dragon、太阳、大声）时隔多年再度合体，巡演规模在K-pop二代团中罕见。同时，KARD确认9月欧洲8城巡演（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846909wpp/kard-announces-dates-and-venues-for-2026-europe-tour)），混声团持续开拓海外市场。剧集方面，6月品牌声誉榜出炉，《我的皇家宿敌》登顶（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846934wpp/june-drama-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-2)），反映观众对古装复仇题材的偏好。此外，CIX成员Hyunsuk签约新公司转型演员（[Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846914wpp/cixs-hyunsuk-signs-with-new-agency-as-actor-unveils-profile-photos)），延续偶像向演员跨界的潮流。

- [BIGBANG巡演规模惊人](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bigbang-2026-world-tour-dates-1235573633/)：31场覆盖四大洲，韩流老牌劲旅的商业价值可见一斑。
- [KARD欧洲巡演日程公布](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846909wpp/kard-announces-dates-and-venues-for-2026-europe-tour)：9月从柏林起跑，混声团在欧陆积累的粉丝基础持续扩大。
- [6月韩剧品牌声誉榜](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846934wpp/june-drama-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-2)：《我的皇家宿敌》力压群雄，MBC这段时间的投入获得回报。

日韩市场的巡演经济已完全恢复，二代团与新生代并行出海；剧集方面“古装+复仇”模式依然吸粉，但能否突破套路化值得观察。
日韩.en:
Korean entertainment is dominated by K-pop comebacks and cross-cultural projects. BIGBANG's stadium tour overshadows the weekly charts, while KARD and Choi Ye-na expand their international reach. The drama brand reputation rankings offer a snapshot of the current viewer landscape.

- **BIGBANG's 20th-anniversary world tour**: 31 shows across four continents, starting later this year. This is the group's largest outing since their military hiatus ([Rolling Stone](https://www.rollingstone.com/music/music-news/bigbang-2026-world-tour-dates-1235573633/)).
- **aespa tops Circle Album Chart**: Their new album 'LEMONADE' debuted at No. 1, with BTS and ILLIT also charting high ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846910wpp/aespa-cortis-alpha-drive-one-bts-and-illit-top-circle-weekly-charts)).
- **KARD announces Europe tour**: The co-ed group will visit eight cities in September, starting in Berlin ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846909wpp/kard-announces-dates-and-venues-for-2026-europe-tour)).
- **Choi Ye-na releases Japanese physical album**: The soloist continues her Japanese market push with a new album dropped on June 10 ([Star News Korea](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBiZmgyTUpIT0JfNjBLdWpOWlVSTUhLdHBmQlp0amQ5NzdpMjBVenlJWE4zYkVkcXZlUXBOSS1mYS1faUJzQ2pKWlBPYjE4aGVuR3l4OGhYWm1QQUZlbE9yWHFJaXkycnZYSGNGU014ZUFEaG1Jd2xIaA)).
- **June drama brand rankings**: 'My Royal Nemesis' leads, followed by other top dramas ([Soompi](https://www.soompi.com/article/1846934wpp/june-drama-brand-reputation-rankings-announced-2)).

Cross-border collaborations – like Ji Chang Wook's Philippine variety show – are on the rise, indicating a push for pan-Asian content. Expect more tie-ups between Korean and Southeast Asian production houses.

微博社区动态.zh:
今日微博热搜被三股娱乐势力瓜分：迪丽热巴与陈飞宇的“情侣手链”疑云、胡彦斌与易梦玲的分手传闻，以及舒淇“拒绝磨皮”皱纹被热议。其中，迪丽热巴陈飞宇话题阅读量飙升，但粉丝与路人观点割裂——有人扒出细节指认“恋情实锤”，也有人斥为“新剧炒作”（[手机新浪网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFA3Wk8xT0loQTVsZ0NoV1pmaHhEM0doNlN0bV9QcnFaQkJjeUx0WmdLdHZIeXNiTFQyU2hxeWpWYWNHVTRRNkxWbnlzOHlRd20zNlpiMUNYU3RFSUc5Vl9pWEpqWQ)）。胡彦斌易梦玲分手事件同样引发讨论，多篇报道梳理半年恋情时间线（[搜狐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQSkItbGZsZ281RE5KaVNrazZheW5DY1kxU19zQmNEWWFwUm9EZnFXdFk4aFA5UGw3ay1rOXpleWkwNkh2S0RIeGprMHJkTjZtc2VXaE5mLWx5cHZ5OHRvNHQxYWU2TllpaERCUG1yX09rc3FvODVXbFRiRlJHQ3QxdjBIbG9pdVY4Ym9JWQ)）。舒淇皱纹热搜则反映大众对“自然美”的舆论分化。此外，《浪姐4》四公舞台“哭与实力”话题（[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiS0FVX3lxTE80RHpmV0UxUTZKdDVJc2EweXhuc1dPTlJXZnUwUlZFdW4zaHlzSmNGX1hYLWJpUmpFVjVxbUxZY2J0UGJWa1BmVUdNYw)）以及张月崩溃大哭（[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTFBHUWdnLThEVWZ6c19mWDRfTWl1QXVxUzZlcHJuQVNuZEZ3YTZGNDMyNkF3Sm5WZVpVSUtTb292R0h0bGtiT1B5UjZuYkNIeE0)）是综艺热度延续。

- [迪丽热巴陈飞宇饰品细节引爆热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTFA3Wk8xT0loQTVsZ0NoV1pmaHhEM0doNlN0bV9QcnFaQkJjeUx0WmdLdHZIeXNiTFQyU2hxeWpWYWNHVTRRNkxWbnlzOHlRd20zNlpiMUNYU3RFSUc5Vl9pWEpqWQ)，双方工作室未回应，舆论场分裂明显。
- [胡彦斌易梦玲分手传闻](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQSkItbGZsZ281RE5KaVNrazZheW5DY1kxU19zQmNEWWFwUm9EZnFXdFk4aFA5UGw3ay1rOXpleWkwNkh2S0RIeGprMHJkTjZtc2VXaE5mLWx5cHZ5OHRvNHQxYWU2TllpaERCUG1yX09rc3FvODVXbFRiRlJHQ3QxdjBIbG9pdVY4Ym9JWQ) 持续霸榜，歌手与网红恋情走到尽头似乎已成定局。
- [舒淇50岁皱纹上热搜](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTFA1Qmw5OWRlSE5XUTNIb0oxS1d4TFFRRmp3WlJ4amxyalVHMGtqc1BFLU5iWVlBeXRBa3YwN2JGd2NncFc0NmFrYnRwenBtekk)：“美不该被定义”话题获大量点赞，但也有人质疑是团队营销。

微博社区娱乐生态仍以“恋情瓜”和“颜值审判”为核心驱动力，但公众对真实与营销的边界越来越敏感，明星团队需更谨慎拿捏分寸。
微博社区动态.en:
Chinese social media is a battlefield of celebrity rumors, beauty standards debates, and reality show drama. Shu Qi's natural aging stance trended, while Dilraba Dilmurat and Chen Feiyu faced dating speculations that fans quickly countered. Hu Yanbin and Yi Mengling's alleged breakup dominated multiple posts, and 'Sisters Who Make Waves' delivered another emotional episode.

- **Shu Qi's no-filter stance goes viral**: The 50-year-old actress rejected digital smoothing, sparking a discussion on beauty standards and aging gracefully ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTFA1Qmw5OWRlSE5XUTNIb0oxS1d4TFFRRmp3WlJ4amxyalVHMGtqc1BFLU5iWVlBeXRBa3YwN2JGd2NncFc0NmFrYnRwenBtekk)).
- **Dilraba-Chen Feiyu rumor backlash**: Fans accused outlets of fabricating a romance using a bracelet coincidence, with many urging focus on her upcoming drama 'Daylight Lamp' ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiY0FVX3lxTE52RFpucXhiaXpoM2FwQm1zRm9CNUl6eGppNk1iY0dUVzNHVlB1czh4TTdfaG02RFZLay00QzBfOE9DdGloeTJxbnQ5b050R0w3YUFWYlVOWnJDMmMzMFZ1MmdDdw)).
- **Hu Yanbin and Yi Mengling breakup talk**: Multiple outlets reported that the singer and model have split after six months, with both remaining silent ([Sohu](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMijAFBVV95cUxQSkItbGZsZ281RE5KaVNrazZheW5DY1kxU19zQmNEWWFwUm9EZnFXdFk4aFA5UGw3ay1rOXpleWkwNkh2S0RIeGprMHJkTjZtc2VXaE5mLWx5cHZ5OHRvNHQxYWU2TllpaERCUG1yX09rc3FvODVXbFRiRlJHQ3QxdjBIbG9pdVY4Ym9JWQ)).
- **'Sisters Who Make Waves' fourth stage**: Zhang Yue's emotional breakdown on the show trended, with many netizens relating to the pressures of team management ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTFBHUWdnLThEVWZ6c19mWDRfTWl1QXVxUzZlcHJuQVNuZEZ3YTZGNDMyNkF3Sm5WZVpVSUtTb292R0h0bGtiT1B5UjZuYkNIeE0)).
- **Bai Lu nominated for Asia Contents Awards**: The actress's nod stirred debate about merit versus hype ([Sina](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMigAFBVV95cUxQcnd1QXE1YnhVSFBwYzlXRlhHdFZZYnQ0czR0b1ZBRUJRS3dXb0NLUGE0UXFiaFl1TmUwSVVKWlRWMV9kNXZ4MzBxbk1hVmVHX0ZDUmZsSllmc2I1dFUwb045a0E2MHNkSXVyQkVfSU16b2hpT3Z0Ty1kUXI5bkEwVw)).

Expect the Dilraba rumor to evolve if any agency statement is issued. The 'Sisters' show continues to drive strong social conversation, making it a key weekly event for advertisers.

中国.zh:
中国娱乐板块今日有两条反差极大的消息：黄晓明48岁考取博士获官方媒体广泛报道（[东方日报](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE55bTduSEM0RlNucmFaTzk1ajMwejdwckpnV1hkM0labXNSV2s0ZUl6bjBESUdVc0pSdFJsM083VHFpUGdwdzZvdVM1VUZoVlFIRXBqWmdyZ0dET19MWWx5alVBNEtMQi1MT3dlU25IYm9Bc2xGTnVfVA)），堪称“励志天花板”；而华谊兄弟王忠军2800万股股票被拍卖（[中国宁波网](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE8xSWdTc1lVdkZBWlhZWF9hSUZHbmdISjl0Wjh3a19GVUc2eXBKVHV1NmpoaDFjemdXU3dfVDg3U2tSdDNKdzFVNVFpalFreXdkS2NhSzk0UEhQSlpyM0RsYU1IbS1hM01R)），股价应声下跌，反映老牌影视公司资金链困局。此外，第一代童星蔡元元离世（[360娱乐](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1mb0NUMVFBOHdPYkFnWG00V3BfOTVCLWl4NEo4c1RIbTFVMGx2NTFmVGVoc3Y1TldaNnlZdXU0YjVKcGJvckFoaENkTktBckE)）引发怀旧潮——他曾主演《红孩子》《小铃铛》等经典，代表一个时代的银幕记忆。产业层面，华策与中国传媒大学签署战略合作协议（[新浪财经](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE9RRDhrX2RVRkF2WXVzUTUzeWVjbFNWbzl6ejhYX3kzX3hNNlBPRXF4WDhxbzNlbGExTVJvRjN3dGFPODRMTzlYNmtWLXlrRno3a0VhcVB3ZjA1aElXOWc1LXNfLWY5SnlaMjBaaGxyZGliOGljQlE)），为影视人才培养和内容创新注入新动力。

- [黄晓明博士上岸](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNSm9FaXMyeTlxcWdWYzVsNEE1OG4wWnVzLW9XQXJKUExWRGYzTGFMNzhEblk2alM1U2JyNUtXT2o3Q2c5ZHc5bS0yRFhrQTBLMVhmT2h5YjQtNmpHVmc4ZzdVLVgtV3FOeEQ1SlhwaTU1Y3hUV01LUThPUGcyZEFadTZ3)：48岁推掉戏约一年备考，回应称“读博是为了更好地理解角色”，圈内外口碑正向。
- [华谊兄弟王忠军股票被拍卖](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE8xSWdTc1lVdkZBWlhZWF9hSUZHbmdISjl0Wjh3a19GVUc2eXBKVHV1NmpoaDFjemdXU3dfVDg3U2tSdDNKdzFVNVFpalFreXdkS2NhSzk0UEhQSlpyM0RsYU1IbS1hM01R)：2800万股占华谊总股本约1%，公司股价当日跌近5%，影视资本寒冬信号尚未解除。
- [第一代童星蔡元元离世](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1mb0NUMVFBOHdPYkFnWG00V3BfOTVCLWl4NEo4c1RIbTFVMGx2NTFmVGVoc3Y1TldaNnlZdXU0YjVKcGJvckFoaENkTktBckE)：享年84岁，网友集体缅怀“童年影像”，也提醒行业关注老一辈艺术家的传承。

中国娱乐市场正经历“个人奋斗”与“行业困境”的二元叙事：黄晓明读书突围展示积极路径，华谊兄弟的拍卖则持续敲响警钟，而人才培养合作或许才是长期解药。

China's entertainment industry news this cycle mixes personal achievements, corporate troubles, and industry collaborations. Huang Xiaoming's doctoral admission draws positive attention, while Huayi Brothers faces shareholder pressure with stock auction. The sector also sees streaming innovation and cross-border content incentives.

- **Huang Xiaoming earns PhD**: The 48-year-old actor passed the doctoral entrance exam after failing last year – he turned down acting roles to focus on studying ([Oriental Daily](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTE55bTduSEM0RlNucmFaTzk1ajMwejdwckpnV1hkM0labXNSV2s0ZUl6bjBESUdVc0pSdFJsM083VHFpUGdwdzZvdVM1VUZoVlFIRXBqWmgyZ0dET19MWWx5alVBNEtMQi1MT3dlU25IYm9Bc2xGTnVfVA), [Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiggFBVV95cUxNSm9FaXMyeTlxcWdWYzVsNEE1OG4wWnVzLW9XQXJKUExWRGYzTGFMNzhEblk2alM1U2JyNUtXT2o3Q2c5ZHc5bS0yRFhrQTBLMVhmT2h5YjQtNmpHVmc4ZzdVLVgtV3FOeEQ1SlhwaTU1Y3hUV01LUThPUGcyZEFadTZ3)).
- **Huayi Brothers stock auction**: Wang Zhongjun's 28 million shares were auctioned, sending the stock down nearly 5% – a sign of ongoing financial strain at the studio ([Ningbo Net](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiaEFVX3lxTE8xSWdTc1lVdkZBWlhZWF9hSUZHbmdISjl0Wjh3a19GVUc2eXBKVHV1NmpoaDFjemdXU3dfVDg3U2tSdDNKdzFVNVFpalFreXdkS2NhSzk0UEhQSlpyM0RsYU1IbS1hM01R)).
- **Huace Film and Communication University of China partnership**: A strategic alliance aimed at nurturing talent and developing new content formats ([Sina Finance](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMidkFVX3lxTE9RRDhrX2RVRkF2WXVzUTUzeWVjbFNWbzl6ejhYX3kzX3hNNlBPRXF4WDhxbzNlbGExTVJvRjN3dGFPODRMTzlYNmtWLXlrRno3a0VhcVB3ZjA1aElXOWc1LXNfLWY5SnlaMjBaaGxyZGliOGljQlE)).
- **First-generation child star Cai Yuanyuan passes away**: The actor, known for early Chinese cinema, died, triggering nostalgic tributes ([360 Entertainment](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMiT0FVX3lxTE1mb0NUMVFBOHdPYkFnWG00V3BfOTVCLWl4NEo4c1RIbTFVMGx2NTFmVGVoc3Y1TldaNnlZdXU0YjVKcGJvckFoaENkTktBckE)).
- **International film market incentives**: At the Shanghai International Film Festival, multiple countries offered tax breaks and filming incentives, aiming to attract Chinese productions ([SIFF](https://news.google.com/rss/articles/CBMieEFVX3lxTFBMWFNwd1A4bDh3M3EybWZ3LUZNNVk3WC1naDZWdVlQc3MxMTBBck4tV2VvYm5fR1VRRzNXZkN4TUxSXzBJMm9ZXzRXWFRkaEt0RF80bmFKczg5OFd6WFYzcFB3WURCSm91UGlxSGM3Zm5qem5hZGJqOA)).

Huang Xiaoming's academic pivot may inspire other celebrities to pursue further education. Meanwhile, the Huayi auction signals continued instability in traditional film companies, while AI-powered microdramas gain traction as a growth area.
